title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
description:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excellence Opérationnelle : Tu assures la gouvernance fine du metastore, la gestion des droits d'accès et intègres au cœur de ta roadmap les enjeux de sécurité, de performance, de maintenance et de FinOps (optimisation des coûts cloud).

  • Leadership Fonctionnel & Synergies : Tu assures le management fonctionnel de l'équipe technique au quotidien et tu pourras être amené·e à animer un groupe transverse de PM sur des sujets communs afin de garantir l'alignement de notre vision produit globale.

  • Mesure de l'impact : Tu définis et suis les indicateurs clés de réussite focalisés sur la fiabilité, la robustesse de la plateforme et la mesure précise de l'usage de tes produits. Tu co-animes le budget du produit avec le leader.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience comme Product Manager, avec une légitimité et une réussite reconnues sur des produits complexes ou de plateforme.

  • Expertise Technique & Data : Tu possèdes une forte appétence technique ainsi qu'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la gestion des données, aux accès et à la gouvernance. Savoir manipuler la donnée est un réel plus pour ce poste.

  • Culture Tech & IA : Tu maîtrises les outils d'Intelligence Artificielle appliqués au Product Management et tu appréhendes parfaitement les défis techniques sous-jacents (sécurité, infrastructure, scalabilité).

  • Soft Skills : Orienté·e utilisateur, tu as un fort sens du service. Tu aimes écouter, creuser des sujets de fond et proposer des solutions innovantes.

  • Communication & Fédérateur·rice : Tu disposes d'excellentes capacités de communication pour vulgariser des concepts complexes, dialoguer aussi bien avec des profils techniques que métiers, et fédérer autour de ta vision.

  • Langues & Mindset : Un niveau d'anglais courant (B2 minimum, écrit et oral) est requis pour évoluer dans notre contexte international. Tu es motivé·e, curieux·se, ambitieux·se et tu as le goût du challenge.

  • L'étincelle Decathlon : Tu es passionné·e de sport, tu as envie de partager tes passions en équipe et de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif !


STACK TECHNIQUE

  • AWS S3, Glue
  • Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog
  • Data contracts
  • Business Intelligence : Tableau
  • Compute et Orchestration : Spark / Scala,  Python,  Airflow, dbt
  • Ops : Terraform, Kubernetes
  • Product Management : Jira Product Discovery, Github, Confluence
  • IA : Gemini, Github Copilot

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

 

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. description:
Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)      


L’équipe Login est le pilier de l’écosystème Decathlon. Composée de profils passionnés et multiculturels, notre équipe d'une dizaine de personnes construit une solution d’authentification sécurisée et haute performance pour plus de 80 pays. Notre ambition ? Offrir une expérience membre fluide via un point d’entrée unique et hautement sécurisé. Notre défi actuel est de taille : mener une migration d'architecture d'envergure internationale depuis notre système Spring Security 5 vers Spring Security 7. Rejoins une équipe de passionné·es au cœur des enjeux globaux de Decathlon !

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

La mission principale est d’accompagner la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités et l’amélioration de l’application, le tout tournant autour d’une organisation s’appuyant sur un écosystème agile afin de délivrer rapidement et fréquemment le plus de valeur possible à nos produits.

Contexte DevSecOps : you build it, you run it, you enjoy it !

Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC : Contribuer à l'implémentation de ces protocoles pour garantir des accès sécurisés à nos services.

Sécurisation du Code : Appliquer les principes de sécurité dès la conception (OWASP, protection contre les injections, gestion sécurisée du cycle de vie des sessions).

Veille Sécurité : Identifier et corriger proactivement les failles potentielles au sein de l'écosystème Java/Spring.

Administration Cloudflare : Gérer, configurer et optimiser notre infrastructure Cloudflare (WAF, protection DDoS, DNS, CDN, Gestion des Bots). 

Audit et Monitoring : Mettre en place la surveillance des menaces, analyser les logs de sécurité et réagir aux incidents (SOC/SIEM).

  • Développement & Delivery

Production : Assurer le delivery sur les briques core du CIAM (moteurs d'authentification, gestion des jetons, intégrations protocolaires).

Qualité Intégrée : Garantir la stabilité via des tests automatisés rigoureux (Playwright, Gatling) dès la phase de développement.

Expérimentation : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'A/B testing via Statsig pour valider les évolutions du tunnel d'authentification de manière granulaire.

Tracking Comportemental : Intégrer et maintenir un tracking précis via Amplitude pour analyser les parcours utilisateurs et identifier les points de friction.

Performance Produit : Collaborer avec les équipes Produit pour traduire les besoins business en implémentations techniques mesurables et scalables.

  • Architecture, Scale & Observabilité

Conception Système : Modéliser les flux complexes via le C4 Model pour assurer une vision claire des interactions entre services.

Infrastructure & Ops : Déployer et opérer tes services sur Kubernetes (Helm), avec une maîtrise totale de l'observabilité via Datadog.

  • +7 ans en Java dans des environnements distribués à fort trafic.
  • Compétence sécurité : 
    • Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC
    • Expérience sur Keycloak ou équivalent
    • Sécurisation du Code (OWASP, injections, sessions sécurisées)
  • Spring & Spring Security : Connaissance des mécanismes internes (Filters, Authentication Providers, etc.).
  • Event-Driven Architecture : Expérience sur Kafka, CDC et utilisation du pattern Outbox.

title: Software Engineer, Regulatory Reporting
description:
About Clear Street:

Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io.

 

The Team:


The Regulatory Reporting Engineering team at Clear Street is a small team with a great deal of responsibility. We work closely with stakeholders to ensure that we meet all our financial and regulatory obligations in a timely fashion. Our goal is to make the lives of our stakeholders easier by leveraging innovative technology to create automated solutions for their workflows. As Clear Street grows into more product lines and geographical regions, every member of the team will have an opportunity to have an immense impact on the firm as a whole.  Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where you can make a significant contribution, collaborate with talented professionals, and work with cutting-edge technology to drive operational excellence.

 

The Role:

As a Lead Software Engineer on the Regulatory Reporting Engineering team, you will play an integral role in automating our Compliance & Finance regulatory processes. You'll build on your analytical skills to create solutions that process large amounts of data from our data warehouse to generate clean, correct reporting, including building out reconciliations.

You will partner with key stakeholders across the Compliance, Finance, and Treasury teams  to understand regulatory/financial obligations and business requirements, and translate them into clean designs and scalable solutions. As the tech lead in the team, you will provide technical guidance, prioritizing work, perform hands-on design and development and code review,  as well as evolve our technical standards and best practices.

 

Tech Stack: Python, SQL, Snowflake, Retool, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo, Metaplane, REST APIs

Required Qualifications: 

  • You have at least three (3) years of software design and development experience including CI/CD, source code control, testing, and quality management.
  • You are highly proficient in Python,  SQL, database design, and have experience working with data warehouses like Snowflake to generate complex solutions at scale.
  • You are a self-starter with a sense of urgency and an eagerness to learn and explore new technologies as appropriate to solve business problems.
  • You are a strong communicator who can interact in a clear and concise manner with non-technical business stakeholders, product managers as well engineers.
  • You can troubleshoot and logically assess problems and determine solutions.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • You have experience working in the post-trade automation space designing and architecting systems that deliver solutions to complex data problems.
  • You have experience generating complex financial industry regulatory reports like EMIR, MFID,  SFTR, CPR, K Factor etc.

 

We Offer:

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week.

Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning
description:
At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change.

Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.

As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse.

You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide.

This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez.

  • Location: This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK.
    Right to Work: Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Own the simulator

  • Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care.
  • Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling.
  • Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites.
  • Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses.
  • Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams.

Tune and close the sim2real gap

  • Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data.
  • Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism.
  • Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity.
  • Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders.
  • Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator

Grow into reinforcement learning

  • Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs.
  • Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms.
  • Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world.
  • Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams.
  • Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus.
  • Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications.

Qualifications

  • A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems.
  • Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar).
  • Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code.
  • Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty.
  • Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains.
  • Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV).
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively and explain uncertain results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences in a multidisciplinary environment.

The expected base salary range for this role is GBP 70,000 - 120,000  based on external market data, plus bonus and equity. Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions.

Additional Information 

Locus Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

  • Strong grasp of pipeline orchestration, testing frameworks and the practices that keep them healthy at scale.

  • Comfortable setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and working closely with finance, payments and audit stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off clearly and influence the decision that follows.

  • You use AI hands-on in your day-to-day technical work and can show specific examples of how it has changed the way you build, review or debug data models.

  • You catch AI's errors before anything ships, including hallucinations, overconfident answers and plausible-but-wrong code, and you have a clear sense of where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.
  • Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.
  • Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.
  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.
  • Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

Qualifications

Education

  • Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.
  • Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.
  • Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

Anticipated Application Deadline: 27 November 2026 (This position may close earlier if a high volume of applications is received before the stated deadline)

raw.title: SAR Manager
raw.description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Financial Crime Intelligence & Investigations Team as a Financial Crime SAR Manager? Reporting to the Senior Manager, you’ll act as a subject matter expert for financial crime intelligence analysis across our client base. Including conducting analysis of potential suspicious activity across a range of financial crime escalations, producing reports for both internal and external audiences, and providing support across the wider team where needed.

Candidates need to have proven experience in financial crime intelligence across different payment platforms and services. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies, detection methods and intelligence analysis techniques, and share this knowledge with other members of the team. You’ll be comfortable working in an energetic environment and dealing with change whilst taking pride in owning and mitigating financial crime risk for the business.

You’ll demonstrate the confidence to raise concerns, shape strategic thinking and make well-informed decisions. You’ll bring strong knowledge of payment services, together with extensive technical and regulatory expertise across financial crime and sanctions in the UK and other jurisdictions, including relevant reporting obligations. You’ll also have a proven ability to identify, assess, and mitigate financial crime risk across the business.

Your role includes:

  • Leading complex financial crime investigations and providing senior-level oversight, challenge and direction on material or high-risk cases

  • Overseeing the allocation and prioritisation of investigative activity, ensuring resources are effectively deployed and key regulatory and operational deadlines are met

  • Building and managing effective relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, providing clear advice, challenge and escalation on financial crime matters

  • Providing oversight of financial crime risks associated with existing and emerging products and services, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are developed and implemented

  • Driving the development of financial crime, sanctions and money laundering typology knowledge across the team and wider business

  • Overseeing complex end-to-end enquiries and ensuring appropriate, timely and risk-based outcomes

  • Directing and overseeing research and intelligence activity to support the identification, assessment and investigation of potentially suspicious activity

  • Providing oversight and approval of relevant regulatory reports and disclosures, ensuring compliance with applicable AML legislation, regulation and reporting obligations

  • Accountable for team outcomes and responsible for complex/high risk decision making

  • Applying extensive technical and regulatory expertise to identify control weaknesses, assess risk exposure and influence appropriate remediation

  • Acting as a senior subject matter expert on financial crime and maintaining awareness of emerging AML trends, typologies and industry developments to strengthen the Bank’s detection and control capabilities

  • Developing strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to influence decision-making, support strategic objectives and deliver effective financial crime risk management

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading and providing oversight of complex financial crime investigations

  • Strong knowledge and practical application of financial crime control frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards

  • Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

  • Understanding of UK and EU AML/CTF legislation (international AML/CTF knowledge is advantageous)

  • Meticulous organisational skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders

  • Understanding of money laundering typologies across a range of products and services

  • Solutions driven, with the appetite for constant improvement

  • In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information

  • A recognised AML/Sanctions/Fraud qualification is highly desirable

  • Previous experience of Delegated Nominated Officer responsibilities would be advantageous

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation.

title: Senior Content Manager
description: Senior Content Manager At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform. The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience. Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale. We're reshaping how we plan and create content at Phrase. A new Content Working Group brings together demand generation, SEO and AI search, paid media, marketing ops, localization and creative under one strategic umbrella. The ambition is clear: every piece of content earns its place, engages in its own right and reflects the quality of the platform we build. We're looking for a Senior Content Manager to sit at the centre of this. Someone who thinks editorially, obsesses over audience and brings the creative confidence to raise the bar across everything we publish. You'll own content strategy and planning, develop and maintain our content calendar, brief and manage writers, coordinate our design studio, and work alongside specialists in paid, organic, demand gen and localization who are collectively invested in the work. You'll also be working with the people building our product (genuine thought leaders in AI and language technology) and with external experts in the field, turning deep knowledge into stories that resonate. This is a chance to shape a content function at a company that takes content seriously, in an industry going through one of its most fascinating periods of change. What you’ll be responsible for: Own the content strategy across the full marketing funnel , working within the Content Working Group to shape quarterly plans, balance priorities and ensure every asset has a clear audience, purpose and measurable goal. Develop and maintain the content calendar to keep a consistent, strategically aligned publishing rhythm across channels and funnel stages. Write, commission and edit content across formats: blog posts, reports, video scripts, campaign narratives, case studies, ebooks, email sequences. You'll write well, and edit even better. For high-value pieces (original research, designed reports, narrative campaigns), you'll commission and manage specialist contributors and agencies to deliver work that genuinely stands out. Apply our editorial approach. We want content that people genuinely want to read, watch and share. Content built on original insight, sharp storytelling and distinctive points of view. You'll champion this standard across the team and help inspire others to aim higher. Compile and present content strategy and plans with confidence and conviction, whether to the Content Working Group, senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders. Coordinate the design studio. Two designers support content production, campaigns, reports and communications. You'll plan and prioritise their workload, keeping jobs moving and ensuring the right work gets the right attention at the right time. Think studio manager: organised, clear, good at keeping plates spinning. Harness AI with intention. Senior Content Manager

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

We're reshaping how we plan and create content at Phrase. A new Content Working Group brings together demand generation, SEO and AI search, paid media, marketing ops, localization and creative under one strategic umbrella. The ambition is clear: every piece of content earns its place, engages in its own right and reflects the quality of the platform we build.

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager to sit at the centre of this. Someone who thinks editorially, obsesses over audience and brings the creative confidence to raise the bar across everything we publish. You'll own content strategy and planning, develop and maintain our content calendar, brief and manage writers, coordinate our design studio, and work alongside specialists in paid, organic, demand gen and localization who are collectively invested in the work. You'll also be working with the people building our product (genuine thought leaders in AI and language technology) and with external experts in the field, turning deep knowledge into stories that resonate.

This is a chance to shape a content function at a company that takes content seriously, in an industry going through one of its most fascinating periods of change.

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Own the content strategy across the full marketing funnel, working within the Content Working Group to shape quarterly plans, balance priorities and ensure every asset has a clear audience, purpose and measurable goal.

  • Develop and maintain the content calendar to keep a consistent, strategically aligned publishing rhythm across channels and funnel stages.

  • Write, commission and edit content across formats: blog posts, reports, video scripts, campaign narratives, case studies, ebooks, email sequences. You'll write well, and edit even better. For high-value pieces (original research, designed reports, narrative campaigns), you'll commission and manage specialist contributors and agencies to deliver work that genuinely stands out.

  • Apply our editorial approach. We want content that people genuinely want to read, watch and share. Content built on original insight, sharp storytelling and distinctive points of view. You'll champion this standard across the team and help inspire others to aim higher.

  • Compile and present content strategy and plans with confidence and conviction, whether to the Content Working Group, senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Coordinate the design studio. Two designers support content production, campaigns, reports and communications. You'll plan and prioritise their workload, keeping jobs moving and ensuring the right work gets the right attention at the right time. Think studio manager: organised, clear, good at keeping plates spinning.

  • Harness AI with intention. Phrase has developed a three-tier content model (Gold, Silver, Bronze) that determines how much human creative investment each piece needs. You'll apply this framework, using AI tools where they accelerate production and protecting the space for original, human-led thinking where it matters most.

  • Fly the flag for content. You'll be the person who pushes for great work, brings energy to the process and motivates the people around you to produce their best. Content touches every part of marketing at Phrase, and we need someone who promotes its value, celebrates what's working and holds the standard when it counts.

  • Track what's working. With support from Marketing Operations, use data and analytics to inform what we create next and to demonstrate content's influence on pipeline and business outcomes.

  • Manage the content budget, allocating resources across writing, design and production.

What you need:

  • 6-10 years in content marketing, editorial or content strategy, with meaningful experience in B2B technology or SaaS.

  • A strong portfolio that shows range: editorial flair, strategic thinking and the ability to shift between a thought leadership piece, a technically grounded blog post and a campaign narrative.

  • Sharp editorial judgement. You know when something is good enough and when it could be better, and you have the skill and the tact to close that gap.

  • Experience managing writers, freelancers or agencies, with a track record of getting strong work out of the people you brief.

  • Confidence with AI content tools. Phrase is an AI company and we expect fluency, not just familiarity.

  • A working knowledge of SEO and genuine curiosity about how AI search is reshaping content discoverability. Comfortable with analytics platforms (e.g. Google Analytics, Semrush) and able to draw insight from performance data.

  • Excellent project management instincts. You can juggle multiple workstreams, keep deadlines honest and stay calm when priorities shift.

  • The ability to coordinate creative resources, keep projects on track and manage competing priorities without losing your composure.

  • Energy! You bring momentum to the teams you work with. You push for great work because you care about it, and that's infectious.

Helpful extras:

  • Experience in localization, language technology or translation. (This isn't essential, but it gives you a head start.)

  • A background in journalism, editorial or publishing.

  • Familiarity with video content production, from scripting to briefing agencies.

  • Experience with HubSpot, WordPress or similar platforms.

You'll be part of a Content Working Group that genuinely debates, challenges and collaborates. Your ideas will shape the plan and your standards will set the tone.

raw.description:
☎️ About fonio
fonio.ai is a market leader in AI agents for SMBs. We started with phone agents and now also cover WhatsApp, web chat, email and a full AI phone system. We’re growing fast across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months, then went from $10M to $20M in about 8 weeks. Today we serve 10,000+ customers.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.
Join one of the fastest-growing companies! 🚀

About fonio

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe’s market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we’re expanding globally and into new products.
We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.
Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

Your Role

As Partnership Account Executive, you own the British and Irish partner channel end to end. Acquisition, activation, and enablement are all yours. You bring new partners in, you get them to their first closed deal, and you give them the resources they need to sell fonio on their own. You handle the full partner base in your market, except the strategic accounts.


This is not desk based partner management. You sell alongside your partners, you sit in their customer calls, and you build the playbooks and materials that make them independent.

What you will own

  • Acquisition: You identify and screen potential partners across the UK and Ireland. You assess their real potential and decide how each one gets handled.

  • Activation: You get partners to their first joint closed deal. You run the sales calls yourself so the partner sees a strong sales process live and learns from it. You join larger customer negotiations.

  • Enablement: You teach partners how to sell fonio. You build and provide the resources they need, from pitch material to objection handling, and you are their go to contact for questions.

  • Account Management: Regular check ins with your partners, unlocking upsell potential in their existing customer base, and opening new customers through and for your partners.

Your targets and KPIs

  • Revenue through partners

  • Number of qualified partners per quarter

  • Number of activated partners (first joint deal closed)

  • Activation rate and repeat activation rate

  • Upsell rate in the existing base

Who we are looking for

  • Languages: English native is a must. German, French, Italian, or Spanish are a plus.

  • Sales background, ideally you have walked the SDR to AE path yourself. Channel or partner experience is an advantage.

  • Hands on closer mentality. You sell yourself and train partners at the same time.

  • Strong self discipline, a real sense of ownership, and genuine drive to prove yourself.

  • You are up for the Vienna start and the move to London afterwards, and you are willing to travel for partner visits and larger customer negotiations on site.

Hiring Process

  • 15 min intro

  • 45 min skill interview & case study with David

  • 20 min Deep dive with our CCO Alex

  • 20 min culture fit with both founders

How we hire?
We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.
Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet 🚀

Compensation: £70K – £120K • Offers Equity

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Brenz suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Teamleiter für die Verladung (m/w/d)

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

Bei der Plukon Brenz GmbH verarbeiten wir mit großer Leidenschaft und Präzision Geflügel zu verschiedensten Produkten. Vor allem Hähnchenprodukte liegen aktuell im Trend. Frisch oder auch tiefgekühlt liefern wir unsere angesagten Geflügelartikel an führende Partner sowohl im deutschen Lebensmittelhandel als auch im Foodservice-Bereich. 

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Unterstützung des Qualitätswesens bei der Umsetzung der Qualitätsziele und Qualitätspolitik im Unternehmen

  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der QM-Vorgaben

  • Gewährleistung der Eignung der Maschinen und Anlagen der Abteilung in Zusammenarbeit mit der Abteilung Technik

  • Durchführung stichprobenartige Reinigungskontrolle / Sichtkontrolle

  • Einteilung, Überwachung und Lenkung aller unterstellten Mitarbeiter

  • Überwachung und Einhaltung des Arbeitsschutzes und Hygienerichtlinien

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich der Lebensmittelproduktion wünschenswert

  • Gute EDV-Kenntnisse

  • Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit

  • Hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Qualitätsbewusstsein

  • Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit

  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Zuverlässigkeit

  • Staplerschein

Das bieten wir:

  • Wir bieten Dir einen spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Vollzeitjob (alternativ Teilzeit - muss von den HR Managern angegeben werden).

  • Bei uns erwartet Dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen freundlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Firmenfitness (wir bezuschussen eine Fitnessstudio Mitgliedschaft im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass-Verbundes).

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Wenn Du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns Dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb Dich einfach über unseren Bewerbungsbutton und das entsprechende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn Du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst Du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.  

Plukon Brenz GmbH
Frau Doreen Klimt
HR | Personalabteilung
Am Brenzer Kanal 2, 19306 Brenz
Telefon: (038757) 515-126
E-Mail: Akquise im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenausschreibung ist nicht erwünscht.

Bei Plukon bist Du Teil eines führenden europäischen Foodkonzerns

Bei Plukon beschäftigt zu sein, bedeutet, an der verantwortungsvollen Ernährung von 265 Mio. Verbraucherinnen und Verbrauchern in Europa mitzuarbeiten. Unser Sortiment reicht von Mahlzeitkomponenten bis hin zu Fertiggerichten und Salaten. Die Zutaten hierfür sind Geflügelfleischprodukte (unsere Basis), aber immer öfter auch Gemüse und alternative Proteine. So haben wir Angebote für Geflügelfans, genauso wie für Flexitarierinnen und Flexitarier sowie für Vegetarierinnen und Vegetarier. Unsere Produkte findet Ihr in ganz Deutschland im Kühlregal von Supermärkten und Schnellrestaurants.

title: Principal Consultant - Strategic Infrastructure Advisory
description: About Infrata Infrata, part of dss+, is a specialist infrastructure advisory business of around 100 people working with investors, lenders, owners, operators and governments across transport, aviation, maritime, energy, digital infrastructure and the energy transition. Our reputation is built on technical and commercial due diligence: fast, rigorous, independent work on the assets and businesses our clients are buying, financing or operating. We are now building on that base to offer clients strategic advice across the full life of an asset, not only at the point of transaction. Why this role Infrata has strong technical expertise and established client relationships. We are looking for someone who can help us build on these strengths by developing new consulting services, winning work and leading projects. You will work with our technical specialists to identify where clients need advice beyond due diligence, develop services we are well placed to deliver, and take them to clients. You will also lead the projects you win, bringing in specialists as needed. Your impact at Infrata The role has three main responsibilities: developing services, winning work and leading delivery. Develop services. Work with clients and colleagues to identify problems we have the expertise to address but do not currently advise on. Develop services we can deliver consistently, with a clear scope, team, price and evidence of their value. Win work. Introduce these services to existing and new clients, lead proposals and presentations, and secure new projects. Lead delivery. Lead the projects you win, agreeing the approach, managing the client relationship and team, and taking responsibility for the quality of the advice. Our due diligence specialists will contribute their expertise; you will be responsible for the overall engagement. Key accountabilities Service development Understand the team's expertise and identify opportunities to offer advisory services beyond due diligence. Test ideas with clients before investing in their development, and focus on those with genuine demand. Define the client need, approach, team, fees and deliverables for each service, supported by evidence of our experience. Build the supporting material: credentials, case studies, proposal templates, pitch decks. Identify opportunities to sell Infrata's data and analytical tools as products or recurring services, and assess whether they are commercially viable. You will establish what clients would pay for and work with our data and technology colleagues to develop it; you are not expected to build the technology yourself. Business development Carry a personal sales target for new strategic advisory work (target to be agreed at offer). Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at investors, lenders, operators and public bodies. Identify opportunities, qualify them, and write or lead proposals and pitches. Work with sector leads to extend existing due diligence relationships into advisory work. Keep the pipeline and client records in our systems current. Engagement leadership Act as lead consultant on engagements you win: scope, plan, staff, budget, and deliver. Define the questions the project needs to answer and the analysis required. Take responsibility for the conclusions and final recommendations. Manage the client relationship day to day, including scope changes, difficult messages and sign-off. Run the project team, including specialists drawn from across Infrata and dss+, and give them clear briefs and feedback. Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget, building client confidence and opportunities for further work. Building the team's consulting capability Coach due diligence staff who work on your engagements in consulting skills: problem structuring, client handling, writing for decision-makers, presenting. Set clear standards for strategic advisory proposals, workplans and deliverables, and apply them in your own work. Help improve resourcing, time recording, project management and cash collection across Infrata. Service areas in scope The role covers four service areas. You should have the experience to lead projects in at least one of these areas and be comfortable selling services across all four. Strategy You will advise owners, operators, developers and public bodies on areas including market entry and growth strategy, asset and portfolio strategy, business planning, governance and assurance, policy and regulatory positioning, and investment case development. Value creation Working primarily with private equity and infrastructure fund investors and their portfolio companies, you will lead engagements such as full-potential reviews, 100-day plans, operational and commercial improvement programmes, exit readiness and portfolio performance reviews. Climate advisory You will support investors, lenders and operators with decarbonisation roadmaps, climate risk and resilience assessments, transition planning, sustainability strategy, and ESG and climate reporting. Data and digital services You will help investors, lenders, operators and public bodies get greater value from data. This could include turning existing traffic, asset, transaction and benchmark data into advisory products or subscription services, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery, and helping clients make better use of their own data. Most projects will combine Infrata's knowledge of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy and digital infrastructure with dss+ expertise in operations, safety and sustainability. Who you are Essential experience At least eight years in management consulting, strategy consulting or advisory, including substantial experience in infrastructure. A background in project finance, lender's or investor's technical advisory, or assurance would help you understand our clients' needs and how our team works. Experience leading strategy, value creation or climate advisory projects, with responsibility for the engagement rather than an individual part of the work. Direct experience of winning work: writing proposals, pitching, negotiating scope and fees, and converting relationships into revenue. Experience developing or launching a new service, product or practice area, including on a small scale. Experience leading mixed teams of generalists and technical specialists. Desirable Hands-on experience of project finance, due diligence or technical assurance on infrastructure transactions, and of the lenders, investors and sponsors involved. Experience working with private equity or infrastructure fund investors on portfolio companies. Sector depth in one of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy or digital infrastructure. Climate, decarbonisation or sustainability advisory experience. Experience commercialising data, analytics or digital products within a professional services business. A second European language, or experience working with teams in Spain, Latin America or Canada. Capabilities Can make sense of complex or poorly defined problems and explain them clearly. Writes and presents for senior decision-makers. Exercises sound commercial judgement on project costs, fees and which opportunities to pursue. Comfortable with technical detail without needing to be the technical expert. Uses AI and data tools confidently and understands when they are useful for clients and when they are not. Technical development skills are not required. Works well with technical specialists, including those new to consulting, earning their trust and helping them contribute effectively. Takes initiative and is comfortable developing new services and ways of working, particularly in the first year. Education and languages Degree in engineering, economics, finance, business, environmental science or a related discipline. MBA or equivalent is useful but not required. Fluent English. Mobility Willing to travel to clients and to Infrata and dss+ offices as the work requires. What you'll experience at dss+ Work alongside investors, lenders, operators and governments on live infrastructure decisions. The opportunity to help build our strategic advisory practice. A values-led organisation and a collaborative, inclusive culture. Competitive compensation, performance incentives, flexible working and international opportunities. dss+ is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, valued and able to contribute fully. #LI-CM1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will work closely with Data Science, who own statistical methodology, and with the teams who own our event tracking and metric definitions, because a number is only as trustworthy as the weakest link in that chain. Who you are We are looking for a Staff level engineer who wants their impact measured by what other teams can now do. You think in systems, you are uncomfortable with numbers you cannot explain, and you raise the bar for the people around you. You have owned an experimentation or feature flagging stack end to end rather than only used one. Whether you built it from first principles or built the missing pieces on top of a vendor matters far less to us than having been accountable for whether the results were correct. You have built the parts that do not come out of the box: assignment that persists correctly, exposure that reflects what a user actually saw, identity resolved across sessions and devices, or the diagnostics that catch a broken experiment early. You are fluent enough in the statistics to be a real partner to data scientists. You can tell the difference between a result that is weak and a result that is invalid, and you can hold your position on a measurement question with someone who does this full time.
