raw.jobDescription:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Ukrainian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Ukrainian

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Ukrainian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

Compensation

Additional Information

raw.jobDescription:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Serbian (Cyrillic) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Serbian (Cyrillic)

What You Will Do

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Serbian (Cyrillic) and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing learning, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

title: Montageplaner (m/w/d) Versorgungstechnik (HKLS)
description: Du arbeitest gerne genau, strukturiert und praxisnah? Du kennst dich mit HKLS-Materialien, Montageabläufen und technischen Details aus und möchtest Pläne erstellen, die auf der Baustelle wirklich funktionieren? Dann bist du bei BIMEXPERTS genau richtig. Für unseren Standort in Vilshofen suchen wir einen Montageplaner (m/w/d) im Bereich Versorgungstechnik (HKLS), der Materialverständnis, eine genaue Ausarbeitung mit einer ausführungsreifen Planung verbindet. Bei uns geht es nicht nur darum, Leitungen zu zeichnen, sondern durchdachte, umsetzbare und nachvollziehbare Montageunterlagen zu erstellen. Aufgaben: Du erstellst Montagepläne und Ausführungsunterlagen im Bereich HKLS in 2D und 3D. Du arbeitest technische Vorgaben, Schemata, Grundrisse, Modelle und Planungsunterlagen in umsetzbare Montagepläne aus. Du achtest auf Leitungsführungen, Einbausituationen, Kollisionspunkte, Revisionsmöglichkeiten und eine praxisgerechte Ausführung. Du berücksichtigst Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formstücke, Armaturen, Dämmungen, Befestigungen, Brandschutzanforderungen und bauliche Gegebenheiten. Du prüfst Planungsstände auf Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit und technische Umsetzbarkeit. Du koordinierst dich persönlich, telefonisch oder online mit Projektbeteiligten und hältst die wesentlichen Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar fest. Du dokumentierst offene Punkte, Änderungen und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar, forderst notwendige Entscheidungen proaktiv ein und schaffst die Voraussetzungen, um selbstständig weiterarbeiten zu können. Du arbeitest mit CAD-/BIM-Tools und hilfst mit, unsere digitalen Planungsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich HKLS, Gebäudetechnik – idealerweise aus einem Installationsunternehmen, der Montage, Bauleitung oder Baustellenpraxis. Du kommst aus der Ausführung und möchtest dich stärker in Richtung Technik, Planung und Montageplanung weiterentwickeln. Du hast Erfahrung in der Montageplanung, Ausführungsplanung oder als Bauleiter im Bereich Heizung, Kälte, Lüftung und Sanitär. Du bringst ein sehr gutes Verständnis für Normen, Produkte, Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formteile, Befestigungen, Dämmungen, Armaturen und Montageabläufe mit. Du kannst 2D Pläne lesen und Zusammenhänge verstehen und Details so ausarbeiten, dass sie ohne Rückfragen mit dem Plan auf der Baustelle baubar sind. Du denkst nicht nur zeichnerisch, sondern auch baustellen-, montage- und ausführungsorientiert. Du arbeitest genau, strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit AutoCAD, Revit, Plancal Nova oder vergleichbaren CAD-/BIM-Systemen. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf B2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Benefits: Anspruchsvolle HKLS-Projekte mit hoher technischer Tiefe, bei denen Genauigkeit zählt und es ausdrücklich erwünscht ist, Fehler, Unklarheiten und Verbesserungspotenziale aktiv anzusprechen. Ein Aufgabenbereich, in dem Genauigkeit, Erfahrung und Materialverständnis wirklich zählen. Moderne Arbeitsmittel, digitale Planungsprozesse und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Bereich BIM. Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung und Technik. Ein Umfeld, in dem praxisnahes Denken, saubere Ausarbeitung und technische Qualität geschätzt werden. Die Möglichkeit, Standards, Vorlagen und Arbeitsabläufe aktiv mitzuverbessern. Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur Pläne erstellt, sondern technische Details versteht und Montageunterlagen so ausarbeitet, dass sie für Projektteam und Baustelle echten Nutzen bringen. Wenn du sorgfältig arbeitest, Erfahrung mit HKLS-Materialien mitbringst und Freude an klarer, strukturierter Planung hast, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Ein klassisches Motivationsschreiben ist nicht zwingend erforderlich. Wir freuen uns jedoch, wenn du uns einen kurzen Einblick in deine Beweggründe und deine Motivation gibst. description:
Host Broadcast Services (HBS) is a leading, independent host broadcast specialist, dedicated to helping international sports federations, organising committees, and rights holders deliver their events to a global audience. We provide world-class broadcast solutions for some of the world’s biggest sporting events, including the prestigious FIFA World Cup™, ensuring broadcasters worldwide can offer fans a unique and engaging viewing experience.

Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, and as part of the Infront Sports & Media group, HBS offers the full spectrum of host broadcast operations and services — combining technological innovation with deep industry expertise to set the benchmark in live sports broadcasting.

🌍 Senior Controlling Manager | Paris | 15-Month Contract | International Group Finance Leadership

📍 Paris, France | International Media & Sports Environment

💬 Fluent in English and French.

📅 CDD - start early 2027 (15-Month Fixed-Term Contract with possible opportunities for extension)

 

Are you a senior finance professional looking for your next challenge in a dynamic, international business?

HBS is seeking an experienced Senior Controlling Manager to lead our international Controlling function on a 15-month fixed-term contract. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will oversee a multi-country controlling team and play a key role in financial planning, reporting, project controlling, and strategic decision-making across our global operations.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading a Controlling team based across France, Switzerland, the UK and the USA
  • Driving financial performance reporting for projects, business units and international subsidiaries
  • Managing budgeting, forecasting, cash flow forecasting and monthly management reporting
    Supporting strategic planning and business growth initiatives
  • Partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance, Operations and Executive Management
  • Contributing to process improvements and ERP development initiatives

What we're looking for:

  • 8+ years' experience in Financial Controlling within an international environment
  • Proven leadership experience, ideally managing geographically dispersed teams
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and project-based financial management
  • Excellent analytical and business partnering skills
  • Achieved Master Degree (or equivalent) in Finance
  • Advanced Excel capabilities; Business Central experience is an advantage
  • Fluent English required; French is beneficial

 

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment and wants to make an immediate impact within a globally recognised sports broadcast organisation.

HBS is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will provide reasonable adjustments to support candidates with disabilities or specific needs throughout the recruitment process.

We thrive on delivering world-class broadcast solutions for major international events. We’re always looking for exceptional individuals who demonstrate:

Strong Communication Skills – Fluent in English, able to navigate an international environment with clarity and professionalism.

Confident & Adaptable Team Players – Thriving in fast-paced, live event settings, where collaboration is key to success.

Technical Excellence & Organisation – Structured, detail-oriented, and proficient in the tools needed to keep operations seamless.

Who is HBS?

You’ve probably watched a football game at some point in your life. Well, if it was a World Cup match, it was likely filmed and produced by the HBS (Host Broadcast Services) team. We are involved in the production of the following events: FIFA World Cup 26™, FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 Australia.

Find out more at www.hbs.tv

Due to the high volume of applications, we may not be able to respond individually to every candidate, but we will do our best to get back to you regarding next steps. Thank you for your interest in joining HBS.

title: Consumer PR - Business Director
description:
Consumer PR - Business Director

Department: Consumer PR & Influence
Location: London
Contract Type: Fixed-Term 12-Months
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Managing Partner 

 

About Ogilvy: 

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International.

Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally; we are proud to be the most awarded influencer agency for eight years running and the recipient of the Cannes Grand Prix for Social & Creator for two consecutive years.  
 
 

The Role: 

As Business Director you will lead client partnership, strategic counsel and integrated delivery across the portfolio, designed to provide the client with fully focused, senior leadership on some of the world’s most iconic FMCG brands. 

The role sits at the intersection of earned-first thinking, culture-led marketing, and integrated agency delivery, ensuring that PR, social, influence and advertising work together to create impact at scale across diverse markets. 
 
This pivotal role places you at the heart of our operations for large FMCG portfolio, one of the world's most iconic and dynamic brands.  

Your remit will span from the initial spark of ideation – identifying trends and innovative opportunities that drive cultural relevance – through the meticulous development of cutting-edge strategies tailored to diverse market nuances and brand objectives. You will lead the charge on defining compelling creative narratives and content frameworks, ensuring brand consistency and breakthrough engagement. Subsequently, you will oversee flawless execution, transforming strategy into impactful activations across various platforms and geographies.  

This role demands a holistic leader capable of driving innovation, navigating complex client relationships, and delivering measurable results within a dynamic, multi-market agency environment. 
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Client leadership & stakeholder management 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day client lead for European and Global teams, building trusted, long-term partnerships
  • Provide strategic counsel across brand, reputation, partnerships and cultural activation
  • Lead complex, multi-market stakeholder management across global, regional and local teams
  • Ensure the FMCG Brand has consistent, senior-level leadership fully embedded in the brand business 

Global & European strategy development 

  • Lead the creation of global and European communications toolkits, frameworks and playbooks that balance global brand consistency with local market nuance
  • Embed earned-first thinking into all toolkits
  • Partner closely with creative and strategy leads to shape culturally relevant, insight-led ideas 

Market management & intelligence 

  • Oversee market engagement across Europe and priority global territories, acting as a central connector between the brands global teams and local markets
  • Ensure clients are consistently informed on market trends, cultural shifts, competitor activity and emerging opportunities
  • Champion local market insight, ensuring work is adaptable, relevant and executable across diverse regions 

Global events & partnerships 

  • Lead the communications strategy and delivery for global brand moments and events, ensuring alignment across markets
  • Play a central role in developing and activating brand partnerships, embedding them seamlessly into toolkits and campaign narratives
  • Work with market and agency leads to bring partnerships to life in locally relevant, culturally resonant ways 

Team leadership & integration 

  • Directly manage a London-based team, working alongside creative and strategy leadership
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture grounded in integration and shared ownership 

What makes this role different: 

  • 100% dedicated to the FMCG portfolio, allowing for deep brand immersion and long-term strategic thinking
  • Operates at true global scale, balancing global brand stewardship with local market realities
  • Deeply partnership-led, with collaborations embedded into brand strategy
  • Strong emphasis on earned-first, culture-first marketing, influencing how integrated campaigns are built from the ground up
  • Sits within a fully integrated agency model, requiring constant collaboration across discipline 

 

Key Leadership Competencies: 

  • Proven experience in global and/or European leadership roles, ideally within FMCG or large-scale consumer brands 
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills — this role is heavily relationship-driven and requires confidence navigating complexity 
  • Strong understanding of how global brands operate across markets, with sensitivity to cultural and market nuance 
  • Demonstrated experience working in integrated agency environments across PR, advertising, social and influence 
  • A passion for culture-led, earned-first marketing and its role in driving brand relevance and business impact 
  • Commercially astute, strategically minded and comfortable operating at senior client level 
  • A genuine interest in — and affinity for — the drinks brands and the wider FMCG landscape 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Defines and communicates the overarching vision for the Influence practice. Develops communication strategies that align the department with agency leadership and fosters a culture of open dialogue and mentorship for senior leaders. 
  • Organisation & Resource Management: Architects the department's operational structure to support profitability and growth. Oversees P&L, leads resource forecasting, and ensures the practice is structured to handle complex, large-scale business needs. 
  • Responsibility & Accountability: Holds ultimate accountability for the entire department's commercial and creative performance. Empowers directors to lead their teams while maintaining transparent, high-level communication with executive leadership on business progress and challenges. 
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Acts as the final point of authority on the most critical business issues. Makes high-stakes decisions that protect the agency's commercial interests and mentors directors in strategic problem-solving. 
  • Growth & Development: Champions and funds a departmental learning culture. Defines the long-term talent strategy, creates career pathways for all levels, and builds a best-in-class team through senior hiring and mentorship. 
  • Ogilvy Values & Behaviours: Acts as the ultimate custodian of the agency's values within the department. Embeds these values into the practice's core processes, from recruitment and client management to performance recognition. 
      

Skills for Your Growth to Client Partner: 
To support your progression, you will be expected to develop capabilities in the following areas: 

  • C-Suite Partnership & Business Acumen: Transition from a practice leader to a C-suite strategic advisor. Develop a deep, holistic understanding of the client's entire business model, competitive landscape, and financial drivers to become an indispensable partner to their most senior leaders. 
  • Integrated Solution Leadership: Evolve from leading a single capability to orchestrating the agency's full suite of services. Master the art of integrating diverse crafts—from brand advertising and PR to consulting and data—to solve the client's most complex business problems. 
  • Enterprise Commercial Strategy: Shift focus from departmental P&L management to owning the entire client commercial relationship. Drive enterprise-level growth by identifying strategic opportunities across the client's organization and negotiating large-scale, multi-year partnerships. 
  • Relationship as the Core Product: Move from a role where the craft is the primary product to one where the strategic client relationship itself is the core deliverable. Your success will be measured by your ability to build unwavering trust and long-term loyalty at the highest levels. 
     

Personal Qualities: 

  • Extensive and proven experience in a senior leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Director or Business Director) within a top-tier agency.
  • Strategic yet pragmatic
  • Culturally curious and globally minded
  • Confident, collaborative and calm under pressure
  • Energised by complexity, scale and partnership-driven work
  • Demonstrated track record of P&L ownership and delivering significant, year-on-year business growth.
  • Proven success in leading and winning multi-million-pound new business pitches.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with experience in shaping departmental culture and developing senior talent.
  • Strategic visionary with the ability to anticipate market trends and define a clear, forward-looking path for the business.
  • Outstanding commercial acumen and sophisticated negotiation skills. 

 

How we help you Thrive: 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare 
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave 
  • Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm 
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure 
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests. 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme 
  • Life Assurance

title: Staff Engineer - Search
description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

As a Staff Engineer on the Search team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: making every employee able to find what they need, and get a trustworthy answer, across Staffbase and the tools around it. Today search spans people, posts, pages, files and connected integrations, and it increasingly feeds AI-generated answers. You'll define how retrieval, ranking and grounded answers work at that scale.

Your north star is a search platform that finds the right thing, fast, for the right person. It must respect permissions on every query, work in every language our customers use, and give answers that cite their sources. You'll build the core, set the quality bar, and decide where we use proven techniques and where we experiment, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.

This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver. You'll shape the direction of an open-ended problem, and you'll measure your work with real relevance data, not gut feeling.

Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Java, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, MongoDB, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, plus LLM and embedding services for retrieval, reranking and summarisation.

The Team

The Search team sits at the heart of how employees find information at Staffbase. We own the full path from query to result: indexing and embeddings, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, ranking and reranking, typeahead, and the AI summaries that answer questions with citations. Search is also a core source of knowledge for Navigator, our AI assistant, and the main way it grounds its answers in company content.

That means two big things. First, we make results relevant: understanding the query, retrieving the right candidates, ranking them well, and doing it in the user's language. Second, we make search safe and fast: every result respects the user's access rights, every tenant stays isolated, and the fast path stays fast. We don't ship relevance changes on a hunch. We run offline evaluations, golden query sets and online signals, and we change one thing at a time.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it

What you'll be doing

  • Define and drive the search and retrieval strategy: hybrid (BM25 + vector) retrieval, reranking, query understanding and rewriting, chunking and embedding choices
  • Build and evolve the core ingestion and query pipeline, from sync and indexing to ranked results and AI summaries with citations
  • Own search quality: build evaluation tooling and golden sets (including unanswerable and permission-varying queries), define relevance metrics, and turn them into decisions
  • Protect the non-negotiables at scale: permission-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, multilingual handling, and graceful degradation when a dependency is slow or down
  • Balance latency, quality and cost, for example what runs on the fast path versus what is allowed on the slow path
  • Make search observable: tracing, relevance dashboards, and a clear way to debug why a result did or did not appear
  • Lead technical strategy and architecture, and document key decisions so others can build on them
  • Take ownership of major technical decisions, proactively addressing bottlenecks and ensuring product quality
  • Work with Product and Design to turn user problems into measurable search improvements
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps with engineering leadership, and coordinate with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)
  • Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, design discussions and experiment reviews
  • Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)

What you need to be successful

  • Proven track record as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead with strong leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience building production search or retrieval systems (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr or similar), including relevance tuning, analyzers, and index design
  • Hands-on experience with modern retrieval: vector/kNN search, hybrid fusion (e.g. RRF), cross-encoder reranking, chunking and embeddings; ideally RAG or LLM-grounded answers
  • A measurement mindset: you've built or used relevance evaluation (recall, MRR, nDCG, golden sets, LLM-as-judge with human checks) and can tell a real improvement from noise
  • Strong understanding of multi-tenant architecture and permission-aware retrieval, with good judgment on security and isolation in search
  • Experience with latency-sensitive systems: budgets, timeouts, caching, fallbacks and degradation
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin/Java (or Go) on the backend; comfortable with React/TypeScript on the frontend
  • Knowledge of architecture and design patterns, and the judgment to make trade-offs and weigh their long-term impact
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain relevance and ranking trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with Product and Design leaders to deliver customer value in an Agile environment
  • Passion for building high-quality software
  • Passion for diversity and inclusion, and the ability to foster a culture where everyone's voice is heard

Nice to have

  • Multilingual search (analyzers, language detection, cross-language retrieval)
  • Query understanding: rewriting, expansion, typeahead and spell correction
  • Prompt-injection and data-poisoning awareness in RAG systems
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme

title: Pullup Entertainment - Cdi - Responsable Comptable Generale (H/F/Nb)
description: Chez PulluP Entertainment, nous avons pour but d’offrir aux joueurs du monde entier des expériences uniques. Vos principales missions seront : 1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations : Supervision de la comptabilité clients (suivi des comptes clients et des relances) et générale (provisions, paie, fiscalités, etc.) Echanges continus et réguliers avec la comptabilité fournisseur Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales et des comptes annuels Assurer le bon suivi du juridique annuel Assurer la gestion des déclarations fiscales de l'entreprise (TVA, IS et autres obligations fiscales). 2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (dont la semestrielle et l’annuelle sont publiées) : Pour les sociétés dont la tenue comptable est internalisée : établissement de clôture complète en collaboration avec les équipes comptables internes Pour les sociétés françaises dont la tenue est externalisée et les sociétés étrangères : assurer le suivi, la communication et la revue des remontées des informations avec la comptable générale en charge Etablissement et suivi des calendriers de clôtures en collaboration avec le contrôle de gestion Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires et fiscales 3- Audit et Comptes consolidés : Vous serez le.a garant.e de la bonne réciprocité des comptes inter-compagnies Vous serez l’interlocuteur.trice principal.e auprès de la société qui effectue les comptes consolidés du Groupe. Point de contact pour les auditeurs autant sur les comptes sociaux que sur les comptes consolidés Vous aurez un rôle essentiel dans l’établissement des rapports financiers semestriels et annuels qui sont publiés 4- Management : Vous encadrerez une équipe de trois personnes en définissant les priorités et les objectifs de l’équipe en accord vos managers Vous participerez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs et à la définition de leur plan de formation Vous serez un soutien de l’équipe pour les tâches quotidiennes 5- Projets Transverses Mise en place de process généralisés et homogénéisés des filiales dont la tenue est internalisée en collaboration avec la Direction financière Déploiement et optimisation des process d'automatisation comptable Participer aux projets d'amélioration des processus et des systèmes financiers Ce que l'on attend de vous : Véritable référent(e) comptable, vous êtes capable de garantir la fiabilité des comptes tout en accompagnant les évolutions d'une organisation en croissance. Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Comptabilité, Finance ou Audit (DSCG, Master CCA ou équivalent), vous disposez d'une solide expertise technique. Vous justifiez d 'au moins 5 années d'expérience en cabinet d'audit ou d'expertise comptable OU d'au moins 7 années d'expérience en comptabilité générale au sein d'un environnement international. Vous avez déjà accompagné des projets structurants (croissance externe, intégration de sociétés, évolution des processus ou des outils financiers) et en maîtrisez les impacts comptables, fiscaux et organisationnels. Vous possédez une expérience réussie en management et savez fédérer, développer et faire monter en compétence vos équipes. Vous maîtrisez les normes comptables françaises (French GAAP), ainsi que les réglementations fiscales et sociales françaises. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et appréciez l'amélioration continue des processus. Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international et êtes capable d'échanger quotidiennement en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Une connaissance de SAP ByDesign constitue un atout apprécié. Ce que l'on dit de vous : Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) capable d'accompagner le business avec pragmatisme et leadership. Vous combinez autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités. Vous savez prendre du recul, prioriser et structurer votre activité dans un environnement en constante évolution. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à embarquer les équipes et à créer des relations de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs. Pédagogue, vous savez rendre accessibles des sujets comptables, fiscaux ou juridiques complexes auprès d'équipes non spécialistes. Votre sens du dialogue, votre assertivité et votre capacité à influencer avec diplomatie vous permettent d'être un véritable partenaire des directions opérationnelles. Vous appréciez les environnements créatifs, dynamiques et internationaux où l'agilité et la collaboration sont essentielles. Ce que nous offrons : Un environnement de travail structuré et respectueux où l’autonomie est valorisée ; Une culture d’excellence soutenue par un programme interne de formations régulières (techniques, managériales, certifications), adapté aux besoins de chaque collaborateur ; Une reconnaissance et valorisation du travail grâce à nos entretiens annuels et professionnels, ouvrant de réelles perspectives d’évolution et de mobilité interne au sein du Groupe ; Un cadre flexible avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine pour encourager l’équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle ; Des outils de travail modernes facilitant la collaboration et l’efficacité au quotidien ; Des moments réguliers de partage et de convivialité (petits déjeuners, soirées, séminaires) renforçant la cohésion d’équipe ; Une ambiance dynamique avec des activités variées (club de langues, soirées jeux, sports, ateliers créatifs). Informations complémentaires Localisation : Paris 19e Métro ligne 7 – Corentin Cariou / RER E – Rosa Parks Télétravail : 2 jours par semaine Accord d’intéressement Poste à pourvoir immédiatement Conformément aux dispositions du Code du travail relatives à la non-discrimination, notamment en matière de handicap, toutes les candidatures sont examinées à compétences égales. Définir la stratégie CRM et la roadmap Customer Lifecycle, pour sortir des triggers purement produits et capitaliser sur les moments de vie client. Faire de la connaissance client un avantage compétitif : piloter les outils data, produire des insights actionnables et évangéliser la culture client en interne. Construire le “Next Best Action” et l'orchestration augmentée par l'IA, pour passer d'un CRM intuitif à un CRM cognitif où la décision d'adressage, le canal, la pression et l'offre sont finement automatisés. Piloter la performance client de bout en bout : indicateurs digitaux et business, ventes croisées, réactivation, revenu par client, repeat, lifetime value. Manager et faire monter en compétences ton équipe de 4 collaboratrices (toutes les 4 sont des Pépites !). Devenir le·la partenaire interne des équipes marketing, produit, data et tech. 💛 Ton équipe : L'entreprise : un comparateur digital dans les secteurs de l’assurance et des services financiers, créé il y a 14 ans et réunissant une centaine de personnes à son siège parisien. En forte croissance, sa culture est tech, rapide et collaborative. Ton équipe : 4 personnes aux métiers complémentaires : une PMO CRM, une responsable de la communication client, une cheffe de projet campagnes et une alternante en production. Une équipe compétente, motivée et franchement top ! Ton manager : le CMO, tout juste promu en interne après avoir lui-même porté le périmètre CRM. Très humain et motivant pour ses équipes, c’est un véritable manager-mentor : il connaît le sujet à fond, accompagne la progression de chacun·e et donne les moyens de réussir. Tes interlocuteurs : tu évolues au sein d’une équipe marketing d’une trentaine de personnes, avec des expertises clés en SEO, acquisition payante, marque, contenu et service client. Tu collabores également avec les équipes data, produit et tech, ainsi qu’avec tes homologues à l’international. 💻 Tes Conditions de travail : Ton bureau : de très beaux bureaux, hyper agréables, dans le 17ème arrondissement de Paris, à côté du Parc Monceau. Le midi : pas de cantine, mais une carte tickets restaurant. Ton package de rémunération : Salaire 100% fixe : entre 65 et 80k€ brut annuels, selon expérience. Participation/Intéressement : participation jusqu'à 10% du salaire annuel selon les objectifs d'entreprise (rentabilité, marge), soit jusqu’à 8k€/an. Un intéressement est en cours de mise en place. Autres avantages : très bonne mutuelle, prime annuelle de vacances (environ 800€ cette année), primes culture et sport, soirées au minimum une fois par mois. Ton rythme : 5 semaines de congés payés Une dizaine de jours de RTT par an. Jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine (et encore plus de souplesse sur juillet/août). Possibilité de semaine en full-remote durant les fêtes de fin d’année. Tes expériences & compétences : Tu as piloté un périmètre CRM de bout en bout, avec la responsabilité du business et pas seulement de la stratégie ou de l'implémentation d'outils. Tu maîtrises les outils du marché type Batch, Braze, Salesforce ou équivalents. Tu as construit une stratégie CRM et une roadmap Customer Lifecycle, avec des parcours automatisés et transactionnels. Tu connais les sujets “Next Best Action” et orchestration augmentée par l'IA. Tu pilotes tes KPI digitaux et business : ventes croisées, réactivation, revenu par client, repeat, lifetime value. Tu as déjà managé hiérarchiquement une équipe. Tu parles anglais couramment, c'est indispensable pour travailler avec le groupe. Les profils “annonceur” comme “conseil” sont bienvenus, à condition d'avoir réellement piloté du business sur le terrain. Ta personnalité : Visionnaire et analytique, tu pars des chiffres et du contexte pour poser une vision client, et surtout tu sais la raconter. Pédagogue et collaboratif·ve, tu embarques le marketing, la data, le produit et la tech, parce que la culture client s'évangélise autant qu'elle se pilote. Manager bienveillant·e et exigeant·e, tu aimes faire grandir une équipe jeune, motivée et déjà très sachante. À l'aise avec le changement, tu as envie de créer plutôt que de faire tourner l'existant. J'aime le fait que le manager ait tenu le périmètre avant toi, il sait exactement de quoi il parle et où il veut aller. title: Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution - Manager
description: Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises. Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions. En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International". L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution est spécialisée en évaluation de préjudice et accompagnement sur le volet financier de précontentieux et contentieux en tant qu’expert de partie dans le cadre de procédures amiables, judiciaires, ou arbitrales, mais également en tant que tiers expert. L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution de Eight Advisory, acteur reconnu sur son marché et en fort développement, recherche un futur manager. En tant que consultant manager, vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur des dossiers pluridisciplinaires afin de développer vos expertises et des compétences transverses sur nos métiers du conseil. Au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, en forte croissance, vous interviendrez sur des missions d’ : · Evaluation de préjudice et de support aux contentieux à forts enjeux pour nos clients (rupture de relations contractuelles, sinistres industriels, litiges post-acquisition, clauses d’ajustement de prix, responsabilité contractuelle, actions en concurrence déloyale et en contrefaçon, etc.). · Expertise financière dans le cadre de revue de grands projets industriels (analyse de l’origine de dérapage et appréciation des risques associés) et d’accompagnement de sociétés dans le cadre de leur changement stratégique (préparation de business plan, aide à la décision dans le cadre de changement structurel). · Investigation financière liée à des problématiques de détournement d’actifs, de manipulation d’états financiers, d’infraction réglementaire etc. · Analyses de gestion en lien avec une mise en responsabilité du dirigeant en cas de défaillance d’entreprise (analyse de l’origine des difficultés, analyse des flux comptables et financiers, détermination de la date de cessation des paiements, etc.). · Ingénierie financière liée à des enjeux haut de bilan et des enjeux opérationnels. Au quotidien, sous la direction des associés du département, vous serez responsable des travaux suivants : · Conception et réalisation des analyses financières et comptables, · Rédaction des projets de livrable, · Animation de la relation avec les différents intervenants présents sur les missions (clients et avocats), · Encadrement et formation d’une équipe de seniors et d'analystes, · Gestion des aspects administratifs des dossiers (organisation de la mission, facturation, suivi des heures). Vos travaux seront adaptés aux besoins de nos clients et auront pour objectif de créer de la valeur dans des situations complexes de précontentieux ou de contentieux. Vous aurez l’occasion : · De bénéficier d’une diversité d’approches (problématiques financières, juridiques, stratégiques et opérationnelles) ; · D’être exposé aux clients et aux avocats, et notamment de participer aux réunions de présentation de nos analyses et d’échanges avec les opérationnels ; · De faire un travail à haute valeur ajoutée pour nos clients. Vous participerez également à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités et au développement de notre activité (organisation d’évènements, rédaction d’article etc.), et aurez l’opportunité de vous investir sur des projets transverses au sein du cabinet (formation, recrutement, RSE, parrainage des juniors etc.). Diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d'un Master CCA, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 5 à 7 ans en cabinet d’audit et vous vous êtes spécialisé(e) en évaluation de préjudice financier. Vous êtes doté (e) de solides bases comptables, de qualités analytiques et rédactionnelles avérées, vous maitrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit et idéalement l’espagnol. Curieux(se), persévérant(e), polyvalent(e), disponible et ambitieux(se), vous savez encadrer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et avez le sens du service client. Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

raw.title: Mid Market Account Executive - EMEA (French Speaking)
raw.description:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Doctolib, Alan, Mistral and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base,with well over 100 in France, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

We are seeking a French-fluent Mid-Market Account Executive to help us win Mid-Market accounts (100-1k employees) by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won.

In this role, you'll focus on new logo acquisition. Our emphasis is on your raw ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

  • 💰 You have strong track record in Mid Market SaaS sales, having closed many $50k+ deals consistently. You have won competitive rip-and-replace opportunities of core/platform technologies.

  • 🎯 You are proactive in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, and are comfortable sourcing >50% of your own pipeline. You're both resourceful and innovative in finding new business opportunities.

  • 🤓 You love becoming a product and industry expert. You're adept at delivering a quick demo to showcase how your solution meets a unique need.

  • ⚔️ You're adept at competitive or evangelical selling in new or established markets.

  • 🎧 You're naturally curious about business problems and take pride in positioning specific & creative solutions that solve those problems.

  • 🏔️ You skillfully guide prospects through the evaluation & buying process—engaging the right stakeholders to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

  • ⚡️ Your peers describe you as action-oriented and persistent. You're always on the leaderboard for outbound effort and pipeline created.

  • ⏱️ You leverage tools to maximize the impact of your prospecting and selling time. You believe in research and personalization to spark a conversation.

  • ⚙️ You are at home managing a pipeline of a dozen or more active opportunities concurrently. You take pride in internal operations, including real-time CRM updates.

  • ✈️ You are willing to travel at least 25% of the time for customer engagements and events.

Requirements:

  • 🤝 You have 2+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$50,000 ACV opportunities

  • 📢 You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

  • 📈 You are a new business hunter and are confident in your abilities to self-source >50% of your own pipeline

  • 🌍 You have sold to multiple regions within EMEA and have strong written and verbal fluency in both English and French

Bonus Points:

  • 🤝 You have sold to Talent or HR personas

  • ☎️ Prior B/SDR experience

You shouldn't apply if:

  • 💼 You're more of a relationship builder who focuses on selling into the install base and aren't excited about a new business focused role.

  • 🎯 You expect Marketing or BDRs to source all of your pipeline for you. This is a hunting role.

  • 💻 You believe that "tech stuff" is the SE's job. Our AEs all develop product acumen while SEs are a partner in our team selling motion.

  • 📊 You prefer to run established playbooks in well defined environments. This role requires creativity and a growth mindset.

  • 🐺 You're a lone wolf. You prefer to go it alone in your pursuit of new business. We believe in a team-selling sales model.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those in a practical exercise. We'll provide you with Mid Market Account Executive info so you can develop a well informed perspective on our customer / sales motion. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

  • Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with a Recruiter to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.

  • Written Exercise - You'll complete a short take home assignment to showcase your outbound muscle.

  • Experience Deep Dive (60 min) - You'll walk the Hiring Manager [Stephanie Maclaurin] through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the professional you are today.

  • Challenge Interview (90 min) - This will be made up of two parts:

    • Discovery and Demo Role Play (60 min)

    • Deal Strategy Discussion (30 min)

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • ￡/€100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. raw.jobDescription:
Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with Multipass, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience.

Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. You can feed that VM data, just as you would on a public cloud like AWS, Azure or GCP.

The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. People sometimes use it as a build farm on a shared server, for example.

As a Software Engineer you are expected to play a leadership role designing, mentoring, reviewing and of course coding.

raw.jobDescription:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring multiple positions from early-career engineers to experienced architects focused on the different dimensions of dependable software: cybersecurity, quality, and safety.

What does it take to bring the world’s open source software into mission-critical systems? At Canonical, we are driving the engineering discipline needed to build secure, reliable, and high-quality products that our automotive and industrial partners can depend on. Ubuntu is already the world’s most widely used Linux distribution in general; we want to make it the world’s best choice for the automotive and industrial sectors too.

We operate at the boundary between upstream open source innovation and the industrial regulatory realities. Our engineers define the concepts, architectures, processes, verification strategies, and certification artifacts to transform a general-purpose platform into a dependable, certifiable foundation for automotive and industrial compute. This is systems-level engineering at scale, requiring precision, rigor, and a deep understanding of how complex software behaves in constrained, regulated environments.

We are looking for engineers and architects who combine an open source hacker and builder mindset with respect for rigorous, standards-driven engineering. You will work across Canonical engineering teams and with leading industrial partners, helping to build this capability from the ground up and shaping how open source enters the most demanding technical domains.

Location: This is a remote role based in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Translate automotive and industrial cybersecurity, quality and safety standards into actionable engineering requirements and perform gap analyses against current capabilities.
  • Drive the creation of structured engineering artifacts, including requirements, traceability models, risk analysis, test strategies, and certification documentation.
  • Collaborate with Canonical engineering teams to align development practices with industrial compliance needs.
  • Design, implement, and execute verification and validation activities required to qualify Ubuntu and other components for regulated environments.
  • Develop and improve automation and tooling to scale traceability, testing, compliance evidence generation, and reporting.
  • Engage with industrial partners to understand their expectations, align external expectations and internal capabilities, and support audits and technical reviews.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Canonical’s internal processes and standards capability as the team scales.

What we are looking for in you

  • Strong software engineering foundation with experience in developing complex systems on Linux.
  • Professional experience with C, C++, and Python in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working within automotive, industrial, or other regulated environments governed by safety, cybersecurity, or quality standards (such as ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, IEC 61508, IEC 62443, SOTIF, or (A)SPICE), and applying them in practice.
  • Experience in system or software architecture, implementation, or verification and validation of complex embedded systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce precise technical documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team and engage with industrial partners.

Additional experience that is valuable

  • Contributions to open source projects, particularly in the area of Software Defined Vehicles.
  • Knowledge of Debian packaging.
  • Experience with Rust or safety-critical software development.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity we will give your application fair consideration.

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

description: L'entreprise Notre client est une entreprise industrielle reconnue, spécialisée dans la conception, la fabrication et la distribution de composants et de systèmes hydrauliques et électrohydrauliques pour les engins mobiles (travaux publics, agricole, manutention). Elle fait partie d'un groupe industriel en développement et s'appuie sur un réseau de points de service de proximité au plus près de ses clients. Le poste Rattaché(e) au Responsable du point de service, vous êtes l'interlocuteur technique et commercial des clients, au comptoir comme sur le terrain. Votre rôle : comprendre leur besoin, proposer la bonne solution hydraulique et développer l'activité de votre secteur. Vos missions Conseil et analyse des besoins Accueillir les clients au comptoir et au téléphone, et identifier leurs besoins par un questionnement précis. Relancer les offres envoyées et suivre votre positionnement commercial. Assurer une veille sur le marché, la concurrence et les nouvelles solutions techniques. Définition de la solution Garantir que le produit ou la solution vendue répond au besoin du client et respecte les normes de sécurité. Vérifier l'adéquation entre le stock, les délais et les attentes du client. Faire appel aux services support (électrique, R&D) pour construire des offres globales. Fabriquer des flexibles hydrauliques sur mesure, dans le respect des normes de sécurité. Gestion des commandes et du magasin Saisir les commandes dans l'ERP, valider les délais et la disponibilité des pièces. Coordonner avec l'ADV et les services support pour les kits qui demandent leur intervention. Suivre quotidiennement le carnet de commandes et informer le client en cas d'aléa. Gérer le stock du magasin et collaborer avec le service finance pour le suivi des règlements. Développement commercial Prospecter par téléphone et sur le terrain. Mettre en place des actions commerciales et faire évoluer la présentation du magasin selon la saisonnalité des activités clients. Faire remonter les informations du terrain à votre responsable. Votre profil Formation : Bac Pro ou BTS en machinisme agricole, TP, mécanique ou techniques industrielles. Expérience appréciée en concession ou garage TP/agricole, au comptoir de pièces techniques ou en mécanique mobile. La conduite d'engins TP ou agricoles (exploitation familiale, emploi saisonnier) est un vrai plus. Vous avez le goût de la vente et du conseil, une réelle curiosité technique et le sens de l'écoute. Vous êtes analytique, organisé(e), à l'aise avec l'informatique et vous aimez le travail en équipe. Ce que nous offrons Des formations internes et fournisseurs sur les produits, et une formation commerciale pour consolider vos compétences. Des perspectives d'évolution au sein du groupe, notamment vers le management d'un point de service. (Avantages : mutuelle, tickets restaurant, intéressement, véhicule.) Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden, Projektpartner und interne Teams und stellst eine klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation sicher.
