Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig koordiniert werden müssen. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und möchtest dein Team unterstützen, motivieren und gemeinsam gute Ergebnisse erreichen. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Benefits Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Projekte im Bereich HKLS oder Elektrotechnik, bei denen du deine technische Erfahrung einbringen und echte Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum, eigenständigen Entscheidungen und der Möglichkeit, Projekte und Teams aktiv zu führen. Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Kommunikation und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kollegen, Technik und Geschäftsführung. Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, lösungsorientiertes Denken und neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Wir suchen nicht einfach jemanden, der Projekte verwaltet, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernehmen, technische Herausforderungen lösen und gemeinsam mit einem Team etwas bewegen möchte. Wenn du Erfahrung in der Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektrotechnik mitbringst, gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Lust hast, Projekte aktiv zu gestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. title: Demo Engineer
description: About this role As Ashby ’s first Demo Engineer, you’ll own the systems that make our demo environments reliable, current, and tailored — the infrastructure the entire go-to-market team leans on to show Ashby at its best. Today, AEs and SEs maintain and configure their own demo accounts by hand. That doesn’t scale: reps lose selling time, demos drift out of date, and every new product release widens the gap between what Ashby can do and what we can actually show live. Your job is to close that gap. This is a net-new role. Right now, the work is split between ad hoc effort and a new set of disposable demo templates the Internal Platform team is building. You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation — customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. You’ll sit within Solutions Engineering, reporting to the Global Head of Solutions Engineering, and partner closely with Internal Platform and Product teams. Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program — release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with. The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical — working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation — who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time. You could be a great fit if: 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments. 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. You get energy from creating systems and tooling that make a whole team more effective over time. 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support. 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect. 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field. 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup. ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you. 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally — with Engineering and with GTM — and can translate their needs into reliable systems. 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into. Bonus points for: 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before. 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale. 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on. 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations. Examples of things you’ll work on: 🧱 Own the scaled demo system — customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team. 🗂 Generate realistic demo data — standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup. 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos — create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally. 🚦 Own demo readiness for new releases — make sure every feature is correctly configured and demoable in demo environments before it ships to GA. 🧪 Stand up trial and sandbox environments — create templated environments prospects can use to test Ashby during the sales cycle. 📚 Document how it all works — maintain clear documentation so the GTM team knows when and how to use each demo environment. Why become a Demo Engineer at Ashby? You’ll define a role that doesn’t exist yet. This is a net-new role designed around a real business need. You won’t inherit a mature playbook — you’ll build the infrastructure that lets the whole GTM team demo at a higher level. Your work will compound. A great live demo helps one deal. A reliable, current, well-documented demo system improves every demo the entire go-to-market team runs. If you like creating leverage, this role has a lot of it. The product gives you something real to work with. Ashby has strong product-market fit, and that matters here. You’re not manufacturing excitement around a weak product — you’re making it effortless to show something that already resonates when it’s shown well. You’ll sit at the intersection of Engineering and GTM. This is a rare blend of technical building and understanding what the field actually needs. You’ll help translate our product releases into live deals — and connect the two. The surface area keeps growing. As we ship new features and expand into new product areas, new verticals, and new geographies, demo needs compound with each release. There is a lot to build, and it only gets more interesting. Reasons you shouldn’t apply: If you want to be customer-facing or closing deals, this isn’t the right role — the impact here happens behind the scenes. If you’re not genuinely hands-on technical — comfortable in JSON, APIs, and data — the core of this job will be frustrating. If you need a fully built environment and a finished playbook, the ambiguity of a 0→1 role with infrastructure still being built will feel uncomfortable. If continuously maintaining and updating environments as the product changes sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this won’t be a fit. If you’d rather build production product features than internal tooling and demo systems, you’ll likely want a different engineering role. Interview Process Our interview process is thorough — we want to make sure this role is the right fit for you and that you’re the right fit for Ashby. Details on the process for this role will be shared by your recruiter. Benefits You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible. Sell a product that our customers are truly excited about. Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive! 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable. $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. About Ashby We’re building the next generation of recruiting software and we’re starting with a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run an efficient and data-driven hiring process. We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

  • 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments.

  • 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. You get energy from creating systems and tooling that make a whole team more effective over time.

  • 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support.

  • 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect.

  • 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field.

  • 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup.

  • ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you.

  • 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally — with Engineering and with GTM — and can translate their needs into reliable systems.

  • 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into.

Bonus points for:

  • 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before.

  • 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale.

  • 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on.

  • 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations.

Examples of things you’ll work on:

  • 🧱 Own the scaled demo system — customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team.

  • 🗂 Generate realistic demo data — standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup.

  • 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos — create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally.

  • 🚦 Own demo readiness for new releases — make sure every feature is correctly configured and demoable in demo environments before it ships to GA.

  • 🧪 Stand up trial and sandbox environments — create templated environments prospects can use to test Ashby during the sales cycle.

  • 📚 Document how it all works — maintain clear documentation so the GTM team knows when and how to use each demo environment.

Why become a Demo Engineer at Ashby?

You’ll define a role that doesn’t exist yet. This is a net-new role designed around a real business need. You won’t inherit a mature playbook — you’ll build the infrastructure that lets the whole GTM team demo at a higher level.

Your work will compound. A great live demo helps one deal. A reliable, current, well-documented demo system improves every demo the entire go-to-market team runs. If you like creating leverage, this role has a lot of it.

The product gives you something real to work with. Ashby has strong product-market fit, and that matters here. You’re not manufacturing excitement around a weak product — you’re making it effortless to show something that already resonates when it’s shown well.

You’ll sit at the intersection of Engineering and GTM. This is a rare blend of technical building and understanding what the field actually needs. You’ll help translate our product releases into live deals — and connect the two.

The surface area keeps growing. As we ship new features and expand into new product areas, new verticals, and new geographies, demo needs compound with each release. There is a lot to build, and it only gets more interesting.

Reasons you shouldn’t apply:

  • If you want to be customer-facing or closing deals, this isn’t the right role — the impact here happens behind the scenes.

  • If you’re not genuinely hands-on technical — comfortable in JSON, APIs, and data — the core of this job will be frustrating.

  • If you need a fully built environment and a finished playbook, the ambiguity of a 0→1 role with infrastructure still being built will feel uncomfortable.

  • If continuously maintaining and updating environments as the product changes sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this won’t be a fit.

  • If you’d rather build production product features than internal tooling and demo systems, you’ll likely want a different engineering role.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough — we want to make sure this role is the right fit for you and that you’re the right fit for Ashby. Details on the process for this role will be shared by your recruiter.

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • Sell a product that our customers are truly excited about.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of recruiting software and we’re starting with a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run an efficient and data-driven hiring process.

We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!).

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit und Teilzeit
description: Über Joberg Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d) – mit Option auf Head of SEO & GEO – OTE 130.000 € – Vollzeit – Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien Die meisten SEO-Stellen suchen jemanden, der Tickets abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der uns sagt, welche Tickets es überhaupt geben sollte. Über uns Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt. Dahinter steht Joberg, eine „kleine“, aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO- und vielleicht in Zukunft in den SEA/GEA-Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du. Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen. Ehrlich gesagt Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Perspektive Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam. Was du bei uns machst Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis. Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode (Framework/SOP). Du baust das Fulfillment und die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass sie mit jedem neuen Kunden besser werden und nicht langsamer. Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht. Was du kannst Google kennst du in- und auswendig: Google Business Profile, Search Console, lokale Rankings und AI Overviews. Du weißt, wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini Quellen auswählen und Unternehmen empfehlen. Du erstellst Websites und Landingpages automatisiert und optimierst sie für SEO und GEO, inklusive strukturierter Daten. Du beherrschst Bewertungsmanagement: mehr echte Bewertungen gewinnen und professionell darauf antworten. Du baust Workflows mit KI und Automationstools, etwa über APIs, n8n oder Make. Du misst Ergebnisse und erklärst sie so, dass Kund:innen sie verstehen. Woran wir merken, dass du es bist Du lebst KI. Du nutzt sie jeden Tag, beruflich wie privat, und probierst neue Modelle aus, bevor jemand danach fragt. Du bist neugierig und ruhst dich nie auf dem Status quo aus. Was gestern funktioniert hat, stellst du heute infrage. Wir müssen dir nichts erklären. Du erklärst uns Dinge, die wir noch nicht wussten. Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert und brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben gibt. Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung, mit einem deutlichen Anteil Local SEO. Je mehr, desto besser. Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift. Du bist einfach eine coole, sympathische Person :) Was du von uns bekommst Eine echte Founding Role mit der Option, Head of SEO & GEO zu werden Ein Gesamteinkommen (OTE) weit über dem Markt, denn wir sind margenstark und teilen den Erfolg Workations: Arbeite auch mal ein paar Wochen von dort, wo andere Urlaub machen. Arbeiten, wo du willst: remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien Flache Hierarchien: keine Freigabeschleifen, eine Entscheidung dauert bei uns ein Telefonat. Budget für die KI-Tools, die du brauchst Start ab Januar 2027 oder wann es für dich passt Gehalt: Fixum 56.200 € brutto im Jahr. On-Target-Earnings (OTE): 130.000 € im Jahr. Wie sich die OTE zusammensetzen, erklären wir dir im ersten Gespräch. So bewirbst du dich Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite mit dem Betreff „Bewerbung Senior SEO & GEO Manager – Vollzeit“: Deinen Lebenslauf Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, maximal eine Seite: Warum reizt dich genau diese Rolle, und was würdest du in den ersten 90 Tagen anders machen als die meisten? Und wie nutzt du KI heute schon im Alltag? Pluspunkte, wenn du magst: Ein Vorstellungsvideo von 1 bis 3 Minuten (die Handykamera reicht, schick einfach den Link). Jeder Extra-Aufwand fließt positiv in die Bewertung ein, ist aber kein Muss. Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns, auch wenn es ein Nein ist. Du kennst jemanden, der perfekt passt? Schick uns den Kontakt. Führt deine Empfehlung zur Einstellung, bedanken wir uns mit 3.000 €, sobald die Person die Probezeit bestanden hat. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Customer Success Manager
description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

You have built a career carrying a number, and now you want to grow big accounts for the long term. This role is for you. You will own renewals and expansion for 30 to 40 of Tenable's strategic customers, including the largest account in EMEA. Retention and growth in these accounts is now a top priority, so your impact will be visible fast. You will be in front of customers and in the room with senior leaders, working side by side with our Enterprise and Commercial Territory Managers and Solutions Engineers as an equal. This is a sales role with a Customer Success title.

Your Opportunity:

Your mandate is to keep our largest customers and grow them. You will protect recurring revenue, find the next opportunity in every account, and set the standard for what a Principal CSM looks like at Tenable. Keep our biggest customers, and keep them growing strategic customers stay when they see the value. You will make it clear, and make it last.

  • Own the full renewal cycle for a multi-million book, with retention as your first measure.

  • Spot churn and downgrade risk early, using adoption data and your own judgement.

  • Negotiate enterprise contracts that protect revenue and open the door to more.

Turn every account into the next big deal, renewals and expansion are an equal share of the role.

  • Run strategic discovery with senior stakeholders to uncover high-value opportunities.

  • Build the business case for upsell and cross-sell across the Tenable platform.

  • Carry an expansion quota, and take ownership of the number.

Win as one account team, you and the Territory Manager are partners, and you often carry the bigger number.

  • Plan each account together with Territory Managers and Solutions Engineers.

  • Lead critical escalations, and bring in Engineering, Support and Professional Services at pace.

  • Share what you hear from customers, so it shapes our product and service.

Shape what Principal means, this is still a new level for us, and you will help define it.

  • Set the playbook for renewals and expansion in strategic accounts.

  • Mentor junior and senior CSMs, and show them what great looks like.

  • Build the experience and profile that opens a path to team leadership.

What success looks like

  • By six months: a plan and a trusted forecast for every strategic account, and a senior contact in each one.

  • By twelve months: retention ahead of baseline, double-digit growth in your book, and a team that looks to you for best practice.

What You'll Need:

  • A sales background, with a record of meeting or beating quota through renewals, upsell and cross-sell.

  • Experience of large, complex accounts and enterprise contract negotiation, ideally using a structured method such as MEDDPICC.

  • The standing to build trusted relationships with senior leaders in large organisations.

  • Comfort with visibility: you share account status openly and welcome scrutiny.

  • A team player who shares knowledge freely and enjoys helping others grow.

  • A hands-on approach: you build your own quotes and keep your own Salesforce records.

  • Curiosity about new tools, including AI-led churn tracking, and an eye for what the data says.

  • Availability for three office days a week in Staines, and travel up to 25% of the time.

Interview Process

Recruiter Screen – 1st Stage - Virtual

Hiring Manager Interview  – 2nd Stage – Virtual/F2F

Panel Interview - 3rd Stage - F2F

Senior Leader Interview - 4th Stage - Virtual/F2F

Exec Level Call - Final Stage - Virtual

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager in Europe, the Associate Marketing Manager is responsible for creating and implementing marketing strategies for categories within the Luxury division, aligned with company goals. They are a key point of contact for specialist departments in London, Paris, and Geneva, including the Salon, in developing that narrative across all consumer touchpoints.

Snr Director West International Cluster, Global Rare BU - Closing Date: November 13, 2027.

This role will be responsible to develop and execute all sales and marketing activities in the relative cluster of countries, with immediate focus on driving the development of GIVLAARI and OXLUMO.

  • Support and challenge regional and local teams in tailoring the global strategy to the specific markets while maintaining global/regional alignment;
  • Allocate investment and drive and track focused execution of cross-functional tactics;
  • Share learnings and best practices across the Global Rare Business Unit.

The role will lead a team of  Field Business Leaders (FBL) across a group of geographies and be the primary interface with local Country Managers and International TTR BU shared services (eg Regional Commercial, Business Operations and and Market Access). They will appropriately partner with Medical and Regional Marketing to ensure optimal alignment, insight sharing and communication.  The Cluster Head will also build and execute the Cluster tactical plan (e.g.,Sales force and HCP target group prioritization,  congress activities, marketing materials) and participate in the regional tactics as appropriate (e.g., European congresses). 

The Cluster Head reports to the VP, International Rare Head.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

Manages the full Commercial Team for the specific geographies (Field Business Leaders and their KAMs)

  • Maximize the commercial potential of Alnylam’s assets through the development and implementation of strategic/operational plans in close collaboration with Global Rare marketing, Medical Affairs and Market Access teams.
  • Define, plan and set the commercial direction for the business within the Cluster, utilizing innovative techniques to drive increased customer value and market penetration
  • Lead the cross-functional team providing vision, motivation, and support and coaching infrastructure to drive the business and achieve portfolio objectives.
  • Partner with Market Access and Country Managers to identify, develop, propose and execute local reimbursement plans, including alignment with appropriate adaptation of European pricing, reimbursement and access strategies
  • Effectively lead and build a high performing commercial team by hiring top talent, addressing talent gaps, upskilling and providing career guidance
  • Take responsibility and accountability to deliver against the agreed commercial and strategic objectives, as well as Quality, Compliance and risk management in the countries of the cluster
  • Ensure that all business activities are in line with company policies, procedures and local guidelines
  • Builds sustainable relationships with local healthcare stakeholders, functions as main partner for local customers and local/ international KOLs
  • Ensure high quality revenue and volume forecasting and brand investment deployment for the cluster
  • Develops and implements innovative, multichannel marketing strategies and tactics in the cluster, including the planning and tracking of commercial spent investment
  • In close collaboration with the Global marketing teams, ensure deep local market and stakeholder insights to inform local tailoring of the strategy and tactics and to help inform the global/regional strategy
  • Contributes to the development of the Global strategic plan and annual tactical plans.
  • Ensure detailed pre-launch and post-launch tracking of agreed KPIs to allow early course correction and ensure execution of key tactics

Qualifications, Key Skills, and Competencies

  • Life Science degree or Business degree
  • Extensive knowledge / experience of working in a bio/pharmaceutical commercial (Sales & Marketing) team
  • Experience in collaboration in Cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrable commercial leadership experience in the biopharmaceutical industry such as a highly successful Sales Manager or Marketing Manager and a strong sales & marketing leader within the specialty therapeutics arena, orphan drugs is a plus.
  • Must have a track record of successful budget management with an understanding of revenue forecasting and expense budget planning and tracking
  • Must have the ability to build and drive a business, whilst possessing innate ‘market-making’ capabilities with natural self-starter, hands-on, entrepreneurial and innovative attitude
  • Strong leadership qualities such as having the ability to attract, motive and retain talent and drive a culture of collaboration, engagement and motivation
  • Ability to provide strategic input at Global level
  • Outstanding knowledge of the Rare Disease space, including Market Access key success factors.
  • Strong network/matrix stakeholder communications skills with both regional and in-country teams
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Relentless external customer and patient focus
  • Outstanding strategic thinking combined with strong execution leadership
  • Inspirational leader, able to energize and motivate cross-functional teams and Sales Force
  • Autonomous working style, pragmatic and operationally oriented, excellent planning and organizing skills
  • Sense of urgency, ethics and responsibility 
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English
  • Openness to travel approximately is required - 60% domestically and some internationally

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

Een goede eerste indruk maken én jezelf ontwikkelen in gastvrijheid en communicatie? Daar krijg je tijdens jouw meewerkstage bij de Frontoffice volop de kans voor. Je bent een van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor bezoekers en bellers en leert hoe je hen vriendelijk en professioneel helpt. Je ontvangt gasten bij de receptie, neemt de telefoon op en voert verschillende administratieve werkzaamheden uit. Zo doe je in de praktijk ervaring op met receptiewerk, telefonie, hospitality, communicatie en administratie.

Omdat we internationaal werken, krijg je ook te maken met buitenlandse bezoekers en telefoongesprekken. Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen perfecte Engelse gesprekken te voeren. Het belangrijkste is dat je het leuk vindt om Engels in de praktijk te gebruiken en hierin steeds beter te worden. Wanneer het rustiger is bij de Frontoffice, dan ondersteun je bij Travel. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. Zo ontdek je niet alleen hoe de Frontoffice werkt, maar krijg je ook inzicht in het organiseren van zakelijke reizen.

Concreet ga je je bezighouden met:

  • Bezoekers ontvangen en leren hoe je zorgt voor een gastvrije en professionele ontvangst;

  • De telefoon aannemen en bellers doorverbinden of verder helpen;

  • Ervaring opdoen met Nederlandse én Engelse telefoongesprekken;

  • Werken met administratieve werkzaamheden en systemen;

  • Ondersteunen bij Travel, bijvoorbeeld bij het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens;

  • Waar mogelijk helpen bij het boeken van hotels en vluchten voor zakelijke reizen;

  • Steeds zelfstandiger meedraaien in de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van de Frontoffice.

Het belangrijkste resultaat van jouw stage? Dat je steeds zelfstandiger kunt meedraaien bij de Frontoffice en jezelf verder ontwikkelt in gastvrijheid, communicatie en administratie. Daarnaast krijg je inzicht in Travel en leer je hoe de organisatie van zakelijke reizen er in de praktijk aan toegaat.


Wij vragen

  • Een mbo-opleiding in de richting van administratie, hospitality, toerisme of vergelijkbaar.

  • Je bent gastrvij en vindt het leuk om mensen te helpen;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en bent georganiseerd;

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en bent leergierig;

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

title: Product Manager - Post Booking
description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip. BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions. In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions. Your Mission As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey. You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace. You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders. Your Responsibilities Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap: Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution. Improve the post-booking passenger experience: Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities. Optimize CRT contact rate: Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant. Use insights to guide decisions: Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs. Build alignment across teams: Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders. Your Qualifications Experience : 3+ years in Product Management, ideally in a consumer marketplace, travel, mobility or another complex transactional product. Experience building products across markets, platforms or service types is a plus. Customer problem-solving: A track record of simplifying complex journeys and helping customers make confident decisions. Analytical approach : Comfortable combining product data, customer feedback and operational insights to identify problems, set priorities and measure results. Cross-functional influence : Able to bring Product, Engineering, Design, Operations and business stakeholders together around clear decisions and outcomes. Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! What we have to offer 2 to 3 days at the office per week 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves 50% healthcare coverage (Alan) Financial support for home office equipment Minimum 25 days holiday per year Local meal plan policy (Swile card) 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable) Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like. A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition. A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager. A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders. A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation. Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours. BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

Inform product and GTM direction based on market opportunity and customer reality. Positioning and messaging Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external. Translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-centric narratives. Shape the content and messaging frameworks that guide all customer-facing communication. Operational impact Activate positioning across the GTM organization through launch alignment, messaging briefings and strategic field engagement. Partner with Sales Enablement to embed messaging frameworks in the field. Drive coherence across website, campaigns, launches and proof points. Refine positioning using win/loss insights and market feedback. Become a product expert: hold regular syncs with Product Managers on releases and roadmap, and turn each release into clear customer value. Remote-first: you've built alignment across time zones without a shared office. An analytical mindset: data is the foundation of most of our decisions. Fluent English, written and spoken. What really sets you apart Strategic thinker, decisive operator : you know when to challenge and when to ship. Problem solver with energy : you move problems forward at pace, even when they sit outside your job description. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in France.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

    • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

    • Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

    • Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

    • Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

    • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

    • High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

    • Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

    • Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000.

      • Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom.

      • Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions.

      • Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure.

      • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows.

      • Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operational challenges and deliver measurable business value.

      • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and operational teams to identify opportunities and develop practical automation solutions.

      • Professional Growth: Take on challenging engineering problems while helping establish the foundations of a growing AI-focused organization.

title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in France. As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures. Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges. Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents. You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks. Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred. Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences. Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments. Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance. Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning. Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities. Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI. Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability. Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance. Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV. Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team. International Collaboration: Collaborate with talented researchers, engineers, and technology professionals across different countries and disciplines. Cutting-Edge AI Research: Work on advanced reinforcement learning, multimodal architectures, generative AI, and next-generation intelligent systems. Research and Innovation: Explore new methodologies and contribute to state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence. Scientific Recognition: Opportunities to publish research and present findings at leading international AI and machine learning conferences. Professional Growth: Develop expertise in emerging AI technologies while contributing to challenging, high-impact research initiatives. Global Technology Environment: Be part of an ambitious, fast-growing organization working across AI, digital finance, peer-to-peer technology, and other innovative fields. Le prêt à porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont gérés directement depuis notre siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que d’autres catégories, incluant le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie et autres, sont développés avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS est de la même manière gérée en dehors de notre siège d’Amsterdam et est notre gamme connaissant la croissance la plus rapide.
 
Nous sommes en contact avec nos consommateurs à différents niveaux, nous assurant que notre approche à la fois en ligne et hors ligne aillent de pair. Nous sommes une entreprise dynamique, à la croissance rapide et inclusive construite sur le professionnalisme et des valeurs fortes. En 2019, KARL LAGERFELD a rejoint la Fashion Pact, une initiative de durabilité mondiale cherchant à transformer le secteur de la mode par le biais d’objectifs dans trois différents domaines : climat, biodiversité et protection des océans, en tant que membre fondateur.

Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Notre portail développeur tourne sous Backstage, et la conformité de nos composants y est aujourd'hui contrôlée par un plugin communautaire. Celui-ci est monolithique et limité à ce que Backstage connaît, c'est-à-dire les composants déclarés dans son catalogue.
Tout le reste du SI — code source hors catalogue, ressources cloud, métriques — n'est contrôlé automatiquement par personne.
 
Comment construire une solution maison capable de définir, collecter et évaluer des règles de conformité sur l'ensemble du SI ?

Objectifs du stage
  • Concevoir l'architecture d'un moteur de règles modulaire : création dynamique de contrôles, checks « as code », exécution de tests avancés
  • Développer le système de collecte de données, puis le moteur d'application des règles sur ces données
  • Réaliser la plateforme centralisée où chaque équipe définit ses propres standards et visualise ses résultats. Et aller au bout de la logique : une remédiation automatique par ouverture de pull requests
  • Bonus : un outil de suivi des migrations (workflows, versions) et un gestionnaire de parc capable de pousser des montées de version sur les services

    • Stack technique
    Backstage, TypeScript, Node.js

    Modalités du stage
  • Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France
  • Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage
  • Rémunération : 2500€ bruts / mois

    • Processus de recrutement
  • Test technique
  • Screening RH avec Camille
  • Entretien avec manager et maître de stage

    En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !
     
    • Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique 
    • Une semaine de travail en 4 jours
    • Opportunité de CDI si tu as atteint les objectifs du stage
    • Coaching de tes soft skills avec les Cours Florent
    • Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…)
    • Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…)
    • Des primes d’intéressement et de participation si tu restes parmi nous à l'issue de ton stage

title: STAGE - ASSISTANT(E) VISUAL DESIGN CREATION (H/F) - NOVEMBRE 2026 (6 MOIS)
description: LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. Pour accompagner la forte croissance de la Maison, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Assistant(e) en VISUAL DESIGN CREATION en stage de 6 mois à partir du mois de novembre 2026. VOTRE RÔLE Au sein de l'équipe Retail Expérience Design, vous accompagnerez votre responsable dans le développement créatif, la production et l'organisation des projets. VOS MISSIONS · Créer des modélisations 3D de boutiques, corners, pop-ups, showrooms et évènements. · Assurer le nettoyage, la reprise et l’amélioration des 3D existantes. · Ressembler et redessiner les plans des espaces. · Participer à la recherche des inspirations. · Participer à la recherche des matériaux et l’organisation de la matériauthèque. · Assister l’élaboration des dossier techniques / prototypes / guides d’installation. · Assister au suivi de la production et aider au processus de coordination et aux installations sur site. · Gérer la mise en page des différents documents pour la communication interne. LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. raw.jobDescription:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

At Masabi, we’re powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible and seamless.

We’re building our next data platform. Our ticketing, validation and payment services already publish events to Kafka, and over the coming year we’re turning those events into a governed lakehouse on AWS that transit agencies, internal teams and our APIs can query. It will replace our current Elasticsearch-based data store.

You’ll join a small Data team of software engineers who design as well as build: choosing approaches, measuring performance and cost, and writing your choices down. You’ll bring software engineering practices to a data platform, from well-tested services and CI checks to infrastructure as code. What you build will shape how agencies and our own teams use their data.

Location_

This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and run the services that ingest Kafka topics into Apache Iceberg tables on AWS, including partitioning, compaction, deduplication and backfills of historical data

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, using AI tools with good judgement, and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Work with the teams that produce the data on data contracts, including Avro schemas with field-level classification, schema evolution rules and the CI checks that enforce them

  • Build privacy and access into the platform: personal data erasure, retention and per-agency access control

  • Build the query layer behind our customer-facing data API, and give others access through Athena

  • Evaluate technical approaches, measure performance and cost, and document the choices you make

  • Migrate existing dashboards, reports and finance extracts onto the new platform

  • Later, build the curated layer of shared metrics and business-ready datasets for BI tools and an AI analytics assistant

About You_

What you’ll need:

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: you write production code, test it properly and work comfortably with Git and CI pipelines

  • AI fluency: you use AI coding tools daily and check their output carefully, especially for SQL, schema changes and anything that affects data correctness

  • Good SQL and some experience building or running data pipelines, so you’re comfortable working with data from source to query

  • A solid grasp of data modelling

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

What will help you thrive:

  • Experience running a lakehouse or data warehouse in production

  • Production experience with Kafka and schemas (ideally Avro)

  • Experience handling personal data, including privacy, retention and access control

  • You’re comfortable making design decisions and explaining the trade-offs, in writing as well as in conversation

  • You enjoy working closely with the teams that produce the data, not just the ones that use it

  • Nice to have: JVM experience (Kotlin or Java), Apache Iceberg, Terraform, AWS Lake Formation, DuckDB

We don’t expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You’ll Learn_

  • How to build a data platform from the ground up for a global fare payment platform used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with a modern lakehouse stack: Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation, Kafka and Avro on AWS

  • How to shape technical direction in a small team, where your design choices and write-ups set the standard

  • How to use AI tools well in real engineering work, in a team that encourages them and cares about getting the results right

Our Stack_

  • Java or Kotlin

  • AWS: S3, Apache Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation (and potentially more query engines)

  • PostgreSQL, DuckDB

  • Kafka with Avro

  • Terraform, GitLab CI

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?
