title: Embedded AI Engineer, On-Device Models
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About the Role Deepgram's speech models are among the fastest and most accurate in the world, and we have deep machinery for running them on NVIDIA GPUs. Our customers need them on everything else: non-NVIDIA accelerators, embedded SoCs, mobile application processors, DSPs and NPUs, and purpose-built devices with tight memory, compute, thermal, and power budgets. When a target platform's standard kernels and runtime can't run a Deepgram model well enough, someone has to go below them. That is this role. As an Embedded AI Engineer on the Partner Platform Engineering team, you work at the lowest layer of our edge stack. You write and optimize custom kernels and operators for specific hardware, collapse models onto device-specific execution units, and do the target-side quantization and assembly-level tuning that standard toolchains can't. You hand what you build up to Applied ML Engineers, who fit Deepgram models to your kernels. Your work is what makes a new hardware platform viable for Deepgram at all. This role is a great fit for a senior embedded engineer who has spent their career close to the metal and wants to point that at speech AI, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram's models get onto new silicon. We'll set the level to your experience. What You'll Do Write and optimize custom kernels and operators (C, C++, Rust, and platform assembly or intrinsics) for non-NVIDIA accelerators, embedded SoCs, DSPs, and NPUs where the vendor's standard operator set is insufficient for Deepgram models. Own target-side optimization: collapse models onto device execution units through quantization, operator fusion, memory layout, and architecture-specific compilation to meet latency, memory, power, and thermal budgets. Integrate with vendor NPU/DSP toolchains and edge inference runtimes, and extend them with custom operators when the graph doesn't map cleanly. Deliver kernels and runtime components as reusable building blocks that Applied ML Engineers can target when adapting models, with clear interfaces and documented constraints. Build performance-critical runtime code for embedded environments, including embedded Linux, bare-metal, and RTOS targets. Establish per-platform benchmarking and validation for latency, accuracy, power, memory footprint, and utilization, and catch regressions before they ship. Partner with silicon and platform vendors on SDK integration and low-level performance tuning for new chipsets and reference platforms. Feed hardware constraints back to Applied ML and Research so model designs are easier to land on constrained targets. You'll Love This Role If You Find deep satisfaction in making a large model run on hardware that was never meant to run it, and still hitting accuracy and latency targets. Reach for the profiler and the ISA manual before you reach for a bigger chip. Would rather write the kernel than wait for the vendor to ship it. Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold start, power draw, thermals, memory fragmentation, cache behavior. Prefer hard, constrained, ship-it problems over open-ended research. Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold-start time, power draw, thermals, and memory fragmentation. It's Important To Us That You Have Experience delivering production systems on resource-constrained hardware — embedded systems, mobile, edge AI, or small low-power devices. Strong proficiency in C, C++, and/or Rust, with experience writing performance-critical code for constrained environments. Hands-on experience with model optimization for on-device deployment, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, or architecture-specific compilation. Familiarity with edge inference runtimes (e.g., ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, ExecuTorch) and/or vendor-specific NPU/DSP toolchains. A strong understanding of hardware-software interaction — CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP architectures, memory hierarchies, fixed-point/integer arithmetic, and power management — and how they affect inference performance. Experience working close to the metal: bare-metal or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), embedded Linux, or microcontroller and edge SoC development. Strong communication skills and a builder mindset — you can scope an ambiguous optimization problem, drive it to a measurable result, and explain the tradeoffs clearly. It Would Be Great if You Had Experience with real-time audio processing on embedded platforms — DSP pipelines, audio codec optimization, wake-word or always-on listening, or streaming inference on microcontrollers and edge SoCs. Depth in ML optimization techniques — custom quantization schemes, mixed-precision inference, or neural architecture search for edge targets. Background in hardware evaluation and benchmarking — systematically comparing accelerators, SoCs, or GPUs for specific workload profiles. Experience shipping AI features in consumer products at scale, and the instinct for what "production quality" means on a battery-powered device. Familiarity with model compilation and optimization toolchains and their tradeoffs across hardware targets. Experience with secure, robust on-device deployment practices — code signing, encrypted model storage, and safe update mechanisms. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

  • Experience working close to the metal: bare-metal or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), embedded Linux, or microcontroller and edge SoC development.

  • Strong communication skills and a builder mindset — you can scope an ambiguous optimization problem, drive it to a measurable result, and explain the tradeoffs clearly.

  • Experience with real-time audio processing on embedded platforms — DSP pipelines, audio codec optimization, wake-word or always-on listening, or streaming inference on microcontrollers and edge SoCs.

  • Background in hardware evaluation and benchmarking — systematically comparing accelerators, SoCs, or GPUs for specific workload profiles.

You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. About Databricks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Role

As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will work with federal, state, and local government customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build and grow with us! Join Flexport Switzerland as a Founding Account Executive 

About the role
This is the first Account Executive position on the ground in Switzerland, Flexport’s newest market. As part of the founding commercial team, you’ll build the territory from the ground up: shaping the go-to-market approach, establishing our first customer relationships, and defining how Flexport operates and wins in the Swiss market.

You’ll drive complex, high-value deals and build long-term strategic partnerships with medium-sized and large customers. These are multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, decision layers and require the ability to translate solutions into value

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.

What you’ll do

Build pipeline and dive deep into the market

  • Build a strategic pipeline through your own prospecting, account planning, and in close collaboration with our SDR team.
  • Represent Flexport at industry events, associations and networks to build the brand.
  • Share market insight and customer feedback with leadership, and help shape the Swiss sales playbook.

Win new business

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first meeting to signed contract, and meet or exceed quota.
  • Lead discovery with senior stakeholders in logistics, procurement, finance, IT, and leadership.
  • Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and backed by clear business cases.
  • Lead pricing, negotiation, and contracting, bringing in Ops, Finance, Legal, and Product as needed.
  • Keep forecasts and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.

Launch and grow customers

  • Own onboarding so new customers ramp smoothly and become our Swiss references.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior customer stakeholders and hand accounts over smoothly to Account Management.
  • Contribute to deal reviews, sales best practices, and peer coaching across the team.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales closing complex deals with several decision-makers, with consistent quota attainment.
  • Logistics, freight forwarding or supply chain experience, combined with tech sales acumen: you can sell a platform as confidently as a freight service.
  • A deep understanding of the Swiss market and local business landscape, with the credibility to engage senior buyers from day one.
  • A self-starter who ramps fast, stays curious and does well with ambiguity and no established playbook.
  • Strong executive presence, plus value-based discovery and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent German and English; French and/or Italian are a plus.

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being part of a thriving multinational environment.
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion-dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your family in one of the most important times in life, the birth of a child. Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity
 At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Interim)
description:
Bouw aan mission-critical technologie op grote schaal
Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we gespecialiseerd in het leveren van mission-critical IT-oplossingen die de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten ondersteunen, met betrouwbaarheid en uitmuntendheid in elke laag. Onze toewijding aan kwaliteit en innovatie drijft ons om op zoek te gaan naar een Senior Devops engineerr met een passie voor het bouwen van robuuste en efficiënte systemen die essentieel zijn voor het succes van onze klanten. Door deel uit te maken van ons team speel je een rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van kritieke digitale infrastructuren, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van de geavanceerde mogelijkheden om complexe uitdagingen op te lossen en grenzen te verleggen in veeleisende omgevingen.

De opdracht:

Je wordt technisch verantwoordelijk voor de end-to-end software release pipeline voor een platform dat uiteindelijk softwaredistributie naar circa 8 miljoen devices ondersteunt.
De omgeving is nog volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarom veel verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en professionaliseren van de release-, test- en deploymentketen.


Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:
 
  • Ontwerpen en operationaliseren van een end-to-end release-, test- en deploymentketen.
  • Ontwerpen en verbeteren van GitHub Actions Workflows voor build, test, validatie, gates en gecontroleerde releases.
  • Inrichten en professionaliseren van de AWS-omgeving, CI/CD en repositorystructuur.
  • Borgen van software supply-chain security, waaronder SBOM, signing, vulnerability scanning en traceerbaarheid.
  • Architectuur vertalen naar concrete technische ontwerpen en werkpakketten.
  • Integraties realiseren met testomgevingen, repositories en PKI/key management.
  • Samenbrengen van engineering, security, testing, operations en externe leveranciers.


Gewenste ervaring:

We zoeken een hands-on senior engineer/technical lead met sterke ervaring in:

  • AWS
  • GitHub & GitHub Actions
  • CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code
  • Linux en runners
  • Release- en deployment automation
  • Artifact- en containerrepositories, bijvoorbeeld Sonatype Nexus
  • Software supply-chain security
  • Technische architectuur en platform engineering
  • Technische aansturing van engineers

Ervaring met PKI, KMS/HSM, containers, embedded software, Yocto, OTA-updates, IoT/device management of hardware-in-the-loop testing is een sterke pré.

It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role

We build internal systems to the same standard as our public products: specified, tested, reviewed and observable. We want engineers who enjoy that rigour and take full ownership of what they ship.

What you will do

  • Design and deliver systems and platforms, including intuitive UIs
  • Build Go services and APIs that connect many data sources
  • Design data models and architecture for connected systems
  • Turn data into clear dashboards and visualisations
  • Build LLM-powered features into everyday workflows
  • Write specs, estimate work and deliver to agreed criteria
  • Set a high bar in code review, testing and documentation
  • Partner with non-technical colleagues to turn needs into tools
  • Mentor engineers and improve how the team works

Who you are

You have deep expertise in at least two of:

  • Back-end services in Go
  • Modern front-end engineering [React/Svelte/TypeScript]
  • Data engineering and analytics
  • Data visualisation
  • Applied LLM/ML in production workflows

You also:

  • Treat testing, security, performance and accessibility as part of the job
  • Handle sensitive people data with care
  • Write clearly and work well in a distributed team
  • Own your work from first spec to production

Nice to have: Python, Go, React, Svelte, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, a history of building tools for HR, finance or operations.

The ideal candidate will use their passion for experimentation and analytics to build tomorrow’s tech organisation. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.

As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical. You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: System Architect
description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production. This role is for you if… you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down. This role isn’t for you if… you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance. Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design. Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams. Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system. Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve. Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production. Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system. Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations. Qualifications MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems. Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead. Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product. Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics. Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact. Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics. Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products. Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements. The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland. Nice to Have Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers. Knowledge of data center power architectures. Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering. Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization. Benefits Equity + competitive salary. Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition. Hybrid work with flexible working times. title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team; Zullen we kennismaken? Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Retail & E-commerce
raw.description:
Jij helpt retailers om AI echt onderdeel van hun dagelijkse operatie te maken.

Duizenden producten, meerdere kanalen, wisselende vraag en klanten die snel antwoord verwachten. In retail en e-commerce liggen veel kansen voor AI, maar alleen als de oplossing aansluit op processen, systemen en mensen.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI op het snijvlak van commerce, data en operatie

Je begrijpt hoe productdata, assortiment, orderstromen, fulfilment, klantenservice en commerciële sturing samenkomen. Denk aan:

  • Agents die productcontent voor duizenden artikelen verrijken en controleren.

  • Een klantenservicetoepassing die retouren en leveringsvragen niet alleen beantwoordt, maar ook de vervolgstappen voorbereidt.

  • Vraagvoorspellingen waar categoriemanagers hun beslissingen op durven te baseren.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in retail of e-commerce: je kent de processen, data en platformen van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met PIM, OMS, ERP of commerceplatformen, en met klassieke ML zoals vraagvoorspelling.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Onderzoeksstage Water en Ruimte
description: 24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem. Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit. Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken. Dit ga je doen Jouw onderzoek: Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening. title: Stage consultancy in de Zorg, onderwijs en sociaal domein
description: 0,8 -1fte uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Zorg en maatschappelijke ontwikkeling| € 600,- Wo Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Wil jij je master-afstudeeronderzoek combineren met praktijkervaring bij een toonaangevend adviesbureau? En wil je bijdragen aan actuele ontwikkelingen in de zorg, het onderwijs of het sociaal domein? Lees dan verder. Voor onze adviesgroep Zorg en Maatschappelijke Ontwikkeling (ZMO) zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en gedreven stagiair voor de periode februari tot en met juni 2027. Je werkt drie dagen per week mee aan adviesopdrachten en besteedt de overige twee dagen aan je afstudeeronderzoek. Tijdens je stage werk je drie dagen samen met ervaren adviseurs en lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan lopende opdrachten. Zo maak je kennis met het adviesvak en ontwikkel je jouw onderzoeks- en adviesvaardigheden. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, gemeenten, zorgaanbieders en onderwijsinstellingen. We helpen hen bij uiteenlopende vraagstukken zoals de organisatie en betaalbaarheid van zorg, de toekomst van het onderwijs en passende ondersteuning voor inwoners. De rode draad in onze opdrachten is dat ze maatschappelijk urgent en bestuurlijk complex zijn. Naast het meewerken aan adviesopdrachten is er ruimte om aan je scriptie te werken. Voor je afstudeeronderzoek draag je zelf een relevant onderwerp aan. Uiteraard denken wij graag met je mee om je onderzoek goed aan te laten sluiten bij onze praktijk, en hoe wij je bijvoorbeeld kunnen helpen met het werven van respondenten voor interviews, of het aanleveren van bestaande use-cases over jouw onderwerp. Dit ga je doen Je ondersteunt en werkt mee bij onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten, bijvoorbeeld bij het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van interviews en werksessies, uitvoeren van kwalitatieve en kwantitatieve analyses, en het meeschrijven aan rapportages en artikelen. Je neemt deel aan teamoverleggen, kennissessies, trainingen en interne bijeenkomsten. Je ondersteunt bij congressen, conferenties en klantbijeenkomsten. Je sluit in overleg aan bij één van de drie teams binnen de afdeling ZMO: team zorg, onderwijs of sociaal domein. Afhankelijk van het team waarin je terecht komt, werk je mee aan thema’s zoals: Sociaal Domein: Je onderzoekt hoe organisaties de Participatiewet en de Wet sociale werkvoorziening (Wsw) toekomstbestendig kunnen uitvoeren. Je adviseert over de strategische koers van het asiel- en inburgeringsbeleid en evalueert hoe de uitvoering bijdraagt aan de beleidsdoelen. Je onderzoekt hoe gemeenten meer grip kunnen krijgen op de kosten van de jeugdzorg en begeleidt hen bij het doorvoeren van verbeteringen. Je ondersteunt gemeenten bij het inrichten en verbeteren van de toegang tot ondersteuning binnen het sociaal domein. Zorg: Je ondersteunt zorgorganisaties bij het versterken van hun weerbaarheid en het waarborgen van de zorgcontinuïteit, zodat noodzakelijke zorg bij verstoringen, zoals uitval van ICT of personeel, kan doorgaan. title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)
description: Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Wil jij werken in een innovatieve onderzoeksomgeving waar geavanceerde simulatoren en interoperabiliteit centraal staan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! Daarnaast: Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar; Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging; Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen; Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context; Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen; Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties; Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s; Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken. Nice to have: Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs); Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren; Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen; Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools; Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4330,- en € 7000,- (bij fulltime dienstverband), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Een goede pensioenregeling Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? raw.jobDescription:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About the Job

Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster.

As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people.

What You Will Do

  • Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible.

  • Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial.

  • Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real-time pipelines, low-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load.

  • Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics.

  • Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements.

  • Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout.

  • Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations.

  • Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one.

  • Your toolkit: Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field

  • 7+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent

  • Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost

  • Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production

  • Low-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter

  • Graph or entity-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus

  • Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability

  • ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent

  • Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority

What This Job is Not

  • It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it.

  • It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed.

  • It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself.

  • It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Delivery Transformation Director to drive the successful execution and growth of large-scale transformation programs. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a proven track record of delivering complex, large-scale projects at top-tier consulting firms. This is a unique opportunity to own the end-to-end delivery of our most strategic client engagements whilst shaping and expanding our solution and delivery capabilities.

Job responsibilities

  • Delivery Leadership: Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex transformation programs. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards, exceeding client expectations.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with C-level executives and key client stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for all program-related matters and proactively manage risks and issues.
  • Team Leadership and Program Management: Provide mentorship and guidance to project teams, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability. Oversee resource allocation, project timelines, and budget management across multiple engagements.
  • Growth and Business Development: Identify and pursue opportunities for program expansion and new business within existing accounts. Partner with the sales and solution teams to contribute to proposals, statements of work, and go-to-market strategies.

Job qualifications

Professional Skills

  • 15+ years of total professional experience, including 8+ years leading complex project delivery within a management consultancy, technology consulting firm, or digital engineering services company.
  • Proven success in leading and delivering multi-million-dollar, multi-year digital transformation programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing fixed price and outcome based deliveries
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong business acumen and a track record of driving business growth.
  • German (B2/C1) required.

Other things to know

Work Modality

Hybrid (with up to 40% client-site travel)

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

title: Senior Engineer I, Total Product Support
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

 

Job’s mission

As a Senior Engineer, Total Product Support at ASM, you will take ownership of highly visible technical projects and drive them from planning through execution and delivery. Acting as the central point connecting engineering teams, operations, and customers, you will ensure that technical solutions are developed, tested, implemented, and supported successfully.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong engineering foundation who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems, and turning technical requirements into clear actions. You do not need to be the subject matter expert in every technical area, but you should be comfortable working with engineers, understanding complex technical concepts, asking the right questions, and keeping projects moving forward.

What you will be working on

  • Lead and coordinate technical projects from initial planning through execution, customer delivery, and program close-out.
  • Develop execution plans, define priorities, coordinate resources, and ensure key project milestones and deliverables are achieved.
  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering teams, technical specialists, operations, management, and customers.
  • Drive the build and qualification phase of technical solutions, including coordinating in-house testing, additional test equipment, technical evaluations, and readiness for customer implementation.
  • Work closely with engineers to understand technical challenges, determine where additional expertise or consultation is required, and drive issues toward resolution.
  • Coordinate directly with customers to understand requirements, provide transparent project updates, and support successful technical implementation.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks and roadblocks early, and communicate openly when plans, deliverables, or timelines are at risk.
  • Analyze project and test outcomes, coordinate follow-up activities, and ensure programs are properly completed and transitioned into customer support.
  • Steer operational activities across multiple stakeholders while maintaining accountability for overall project execution.
  • Provide clear and concise reporting on high-visibility projects to stakeholders and management.

 

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • A solid engineering foundation and the ability to understand and communicate technical concepts across different engineering disciplines.
  • Strong project coordination skills with the ability to plan, organize, and drive activities from start to finish.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to work with engineers, managers, and customers.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a proactive and hands-on approach to solving problems.
  • Ability to identify risks, communicate challenges transparently, and escalate issues when necessary rather than waiting for problems to resolve themselves.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, processes, and technical environments.
  • High energy, adaptability, and a strong “can-do” mentality.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

 

What sets you apart

  • Experience working in semiconductor equipment, high-tech manufacturing, mechanical/electrical systems, or another complex engineering environment (not required).
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and translating between technical specialists, operations, management, and customers.
  • Relevant professional, internship, research, or project experience demonstrating the ability to coordinate technical work and drive execution is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions, raise concerns, and create alignment across different stakeholders.
  • A structured approach to project execution combined with the flexibility to adapt when technical priorities change.
  • Comfortable taking accountability for highly visible projects where clear and timely communication is essential.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, typically 1–2 times per year, depending on project and customer needs.

 

 

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description: You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations. Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations. Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed. Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor. Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better. Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck. You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it You're open to travel 30-50% of the time This is how we'll set you up in your first six months: Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account. Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team. Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion. Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like: Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field Bonus: Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments Fluency in German, French, or another European language WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech. title: Software Lead Engineer | NTS Eindhoven
description: At NTS, we make it possible together. Technology inspires and drives us; it is our passion. Every day we work on unique solutions to complex challenges. Whether it's ultra-complex or ultra-precise solutions, we are proud of what we do and what we deliver. Want to set the technical direction of complex software projects and guide engineering teams towards reliable, high-quality solutions? Are you passionate about software development and high-tech product development, and do you enjoy combining technical expertise with technical leadership? Then get started as Software Lead Engineer at NTS Eindhoven and let's make it possible together. Job Description As Software Lead Engineer/ Technical Lead at NTS Eindhoven, you set the technical direction for our software projects and coordinate the technical work of the engineers assigned to them. Working in collaborative teams of fewer than ten colleagues, you translate project objectives and complex requirements into software architecture, design decisions and executable technical plans. This is a technical leadership role without line-management responsibility. You lead through technical direction, coordination and coaching, while the Group Lead or Competence Manager remains responsible for people management. Our teams develop qualification tools, semiconductor equipment, defence and healthcare systems, and other advanced technology solutions. You collaborate closely with software, mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineers to deliver integrated system solutions that meet high quality standards. We value clear and transparent communication. You proactively identify technical risks and roadblocks, support the team in resolving challenges and ensure that solutions are delivered in line with project objectives. Furthermore, your key responsibilities are: Lead the technical side of software projects, including architecture, design and technical decision-making; Coordinate the technical work of engineers allocated to your projects and ensure alignment with project plans; Provide accurate technical estimates and planning input to project managers; Safeguard software quality by promoting best practices, code reviews and effective test strategies; Identify technical risks and roadblocks early and define and implement mitigation actions; Coach and support colleagues technically, encourage knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement; Stay close to the code and contribute hands-on whenever required. Job Requirements To be successful in this role, you bring a strong combination of technical expertise, leadership capabilities and interpersonal skills. title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Robotics Platform
description: At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain robotics middleware and application frameworks using modern C++ on embedded Linux. Own significant platform components from technical design and implementation through validation, deployment, and operation across Serve’s robot fleet. Partner with software teams using the robot platform to identify reliability, performance, and developer experience problems and deliver reusable solutions. Collaborate with Autonomy and Systems Engineering on risk assessments, failure analysis, fault-handling strategies, and software architecture. Translate system-level safety and reliability requirements into software behavior, interfaces, and verification strategies. Develop instrumentation, benchmarks, logging, tracing, and fleet-level metrics to measure and improve software performance, reliability, and system health. Diagnose and resolve complex system-level issues involving concurrency, scheduling, interprocess communication, networking, and constrained compute resources. Evaluate technical tradeoffs and contribute to architectural decisions that improve the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of the robotics platform. Lead technical design and code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and technical documentation. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers through design discussions, problem solving, and knowledge sharing. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience developing production software in modern C++ (C++17 and newer). Experience developing and debugging systems software in embedded Linux environments. Strong understanding of multithreaded programming, concurrency, synchronization, interprocess communication, and systems-level software development. Experience designing software for latency-sensitive, safety-related, real-time, or high-reliability systems. Experience profiling and optimizing embedded software for performance, reliability, and resource utilization. Experience independently owning complex software components through design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across software and hardware boundaries. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across software, systems, and hardware engineering teams. What Makes You Stand Out Experience developing middleware for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or similar complex systems. Experience developing and deploying production software on NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded computing platforms. Knowledge of Linux internals, scheduling, resource management, device interfaces, and interprocess communication mechanisms. Experience with fault-tolerant architecture, failure-mode analysis, functional safety, or safety-related software development. Experience with distributed systems, networking, RPC frameworks, or serialization technologies such as Protocol Buffers, FlatBuffers, or Cap’n Proto. Experience developing telemetry, observability, health monitoring, or diagnostic capabilities for robotics or distributed device fleets. Experience integrating software with sensors, embedded hardware, or other robotic system components. Additional Information: This role works across multiple engineering disciplines and balances hands-on software development with systems-level problem solving, technical design, and cross-functional collaboration. The position may occasionally require access to robotics hardware or onsite participation in integration, testing, troubleshooting, or validation activities.
