MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement. Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement. The role ensures that MSF International: Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities. Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee); Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care; Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems; Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization; Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management; Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland. The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International. III. ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments. Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners. a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services. b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments. c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services. d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope. e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates. f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests. 2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making. Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated. a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance. b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International. c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations. d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International. e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use. f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law. g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans. 3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery. Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations. a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded. b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy. c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency. d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues. 4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements. Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives. a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International. b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation. c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements. d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel. e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International. f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International 5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce. Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture. a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning. b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning. d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication. e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office. f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration. g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation. h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International. IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International. The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent. The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity. V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels. Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour. Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating. Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms. Education Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience Experience Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations MSF experience is a major asset Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies Knowledge Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values. High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters. Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset. Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset. Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change. Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels. Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally. High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation. Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate. Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience. Languages Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential. French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

  • Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

  • Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

  • Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements

  • Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

  • Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

  • Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

  • Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus:

  • Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

  • Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Train and support project teams on validation procedures, tools, documentation standards, and best practices. title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Platform
description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is understood, trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform. As the scale and diversity of content continue to grow—driven by advances in AI, new creation tools, and emerging content formats—we’re investing in intelligent systems that can understand, evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale. We’re hiring Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineers to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and decisioning across Spotify. Depending on your experience and interests, you may focus on areas ranging from multimodal content understanding and platform-level ML systems to safety, risk detection, policy enforcement, and compliance. You’ll help shape the architecture and technical strategy behind how Spotify understands and makes decisions about content at global scale. This work is foundational to delivering safe, high-quality experiences for listeners and creators while enabling new ways for people to interact with content across Spotify. classification, moderation, ranking, risk detection, and content evaluation Develop automated decisioning systems that support content quality, integrity, safety, and policy compliance at scale Design in—multimodal machine learning across areas such as text, audio, image, or video You have built systems where machine learning outputs inform or automate real-world decisions You understand how to system reliability You’re an experienced technical leader who communicates clearly, mentors others, and can influence across technical and non-technical teams Where You Will Be This role is based in New York. raw.jobDescription:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Database Programmer is responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance, and archiving of clinical study databases throughout the study lifecycle. This role will play a key part in supporting the deployment, adoption, and ongoing development of Medidata Rave EDC as Alimentiv expands its Electronic Data Capture (EDC) capabilities.

The successful candidate will bring hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC and C# programming to develop custom functions, support database configurations, and contribute to clinical database programming activities independently. Working closely with internal project teams and sponsors, this position will help ensure successful database delivery, technical support, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and maintain clinical study databases throughout the study lifecycle.

  • Support the deployment, implementation, and ongoing adoption of Medidata Rave EDC across clinical studies.

  • Develop, program, and test custom functions using C# to support Medidata Rave EDC functionality.

  • Create annotated electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs) and program automated edit checks to support data validation.

  • Develop and test files required for electronic data uploads, data transfers, and integrations.

  • Program and generate clinical data listings and project tracking reports to support ongoing studies.

  • Manage database access, process change request (CR) publishing requests, and archive electronic data and documentation upon study completion.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve database programming issues, providing technical expertise and support to internal teams and sponsors.

  • Communicate database setup progress, project milestones, and technical issues to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of database programming processes and departmental procedures.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A post-secondary certificate or diploma from a college, training institute, or equivalent institution. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

  • A minimum of 1–3 years of related database programming experience, with 4–6 years preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC, including clinical database development, configuration, and maintenance.

  • Proficiency in C# programming, with the ability to independently develop, test, and troubleshoot custom functions within Medidata Rave EDC.

  • Experience developing and maintaining electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs) and automated edit checks.

  • Knowledge of clinical database programming processes, including data transfers, electronic data uploads, and reporting.

  • Experience generating clinical data listings and project tracking reports.

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently address database programming challenges.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with internal project teams, sponsors, and external stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet project milestones.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Please note that the salary range may vary depending on the country in which the position is based.

Performance-Based Incentive Program

At Alimentiv, we recognize and reward great performance. In addition to a competitive salary, eligible employees can participate in our Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP), which offers the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on individual contributions, team achievements, and company performance.

description: Music Expression builds the tools artists use to show who they are on Spotify and to connect with fans. A song doesn't have to be just a track in a list. Every one of those things was built by this org. Each squad owns part of the artist-to-fan journey. The work runs from video pipelines and serving infrastructure through mobile and web clients to rights systems, so engineers get real depth and range. Product, design, data science, research and product marketing work inside the squads, and they work directly with artists and labels. Company Description

Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

Job Description

JS Held’s Accident Reconstruction practice is seeking an Accident Reconstruction Engineer. The ideal candidate for this position has a strong interest in accident reconstruction, as well as a foundation of experience in expert witness testimony. In addition to their core engineering work, candidates will be responsible for developing business opportunities with current and prospective clients, mentoring and training junior engineers, and occasionally participating in informative presentations for clients and peers.

Candidates should feel comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative consulting environment which requires a high degree of self-motivation, professionalism, organization, responsiveness, and resilience to stress. Willingness to grow into a testifying expert/role is also highly preferred.

 

Hiring in Several Locations Across the US including: Charlotte, NC, Miami, FL, Atlanta, GA.

 

  • Manage accident reconstruction projects and clients.
  • Conduct unbiased field investigations and testing of incidents and/or loss events.
  • Provide technical findings, analysis, and conclusions, either verbally or in writing, in a timely fashion and in laymen’s terms.
  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities.
  • Travel for inspections, field work, marketing, and business development.
  • Maintain communication with client and project team on status and scope of assigned projects.
  • Maintain technical and professional knowledge related to the engineer’s practice area(s) through attending continuing education courses and workshops, attending industry/practice related seminars, reviewing relevant scientific and professional publications, and participating in professional organizations and societies.
  • Continuously meet or exceed assigned performance metrics and goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an Engineering field is preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of post-academic industry engineering experience preferred.
  • Foundation of testifying experience preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience in technical reports is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attitude to deliver results. Experience managing teams is preferred.
  • Mathematically and technologically inclined with the ability to adapt to new environments or scenarios quickly.
  • Skilled with software and technical systems.
  • Willingness and ability to obtain additional licensure and certification.
  • Ability to work remotely or while travelling to different job sites. (reliable cellular service, access to high-speed data, etc.)
  • Willingness and desire to work above and beyond the minimum performance and goal requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree
  • Licensed PE, or ability to obtain within 1 year.
  • ACTAR certification or ability to obtain within 1 year.

Physical and Mental Job Qualifications

  • Must be able to travel to different regions throughout the United States. (have reliable transportation, etc.)

Additional Information

Additional Information

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

 

  • Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
  • Flexible Time Off policy
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401k Match
  • Commuter Benefit

 

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $100k-180k. Any offered salary range is based on a wide array of factors including but not limited to skillset, experience, training, location, scope of role, management responsibility, etc.

Other Duties

raw.jobDescription:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is motivated to design, develop, test, and operate cutting-edge, highly scalable enterprise SaaS applications, and who can own significant components end-to-end while raising the technical bar around them.

Location & Work Arrangements

This role is based in our Foster City, CA office and follows a hybrid work model. Team members are expected to work onsite three days per week to foster collaboration, innovation, and team connectivity.

This is not a fully remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Work with product management and other engineering teams to design, build, and operate Zuora's next-generation Revenue product.
  • Design and develop highly flexible common components and APIs that enable product customizability and extensibility.
  • Own the design and delivery of significant features or components within the team, from design through production support.
  • Design and develop application components and services for scale, using modern backend and cloud-native patterns, including microservices, APIs, and event-driven integrations where appropriate.
  • Understand the platform needs of other functional areas and provide design and development assistance as required.
  • Understand user needs and build products that are intuitive and easy to use.
  • Advocate for high-quality software and promote best practices to produce reliable, maintainable, and fault-tolerant systems.
  • Participate in and help facilitate design and code reviews, raising the bar on engineering practices, code quality, observability, and testability.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, code review, and technical guidance.
  • Identify technical debt within your area and propose pragmatic ways to address it alongside feature work.
  • Help drive Zuora's transition to microservices and cloud-based architecture.

Qualifications

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a relevant degree.
  • 8+ years of software development experience specializing in enterprise SaaS software.
  • Strong programming experience in Java, Python, or another object-oriented language.
  • Strong database and SQL knowledge, including Oracle or MySQL, data modeling, query analysis, transactions, and performance tuning. Plus experience with MongoDB and Redis.
  • Experience designing and building web applications, with expertise in related concepts such as web services, SOA, RPC (REST, gRPC, Thrift), and API design.
  • In-depth knowledge of common algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and their applications.
  • Experience with production software delivery, CI/CD, observability, troubleshooting, and operational ownership.
  • Track record of owning features or components end-to-end, from design through production.
  • Good verbal and written communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to teammates and cross-functional partners.
  • A demonstrated AI-first approach to engineering, leveraging AI across the design, development, and testing lifecycle to accelerate delivery, and drive impact beyond core areas of expertise.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Cloud and DevOps technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, AWS services).
  • Experience implementing and operating performant, scalable distributed systems, particularly a SaaS product.
  • Exposure to big data and NoSQL technologies.
  • Familiarity with web application and UI concepts like AJAX, SPA, and sessions.
  • Experience in payments, billing, financial systems, or other high-scale transaction platforms.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching junior engineers.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical Insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
  • Mental wellbeing resources and support

*Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora

ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:

  • Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
  • Learn constantly and iterate often
  • Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. raw.position: ML Inference Engineer â Terminal-Bench Task Designer (vLLM / SGLang / TensorRT-LLM)
raw.description:
Overview

We are building a benchmark that tests how well AI agents handle real expert work in a terminal. We are hiring ML inference and serving experts to turn real, paid tasks from their jobs into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the environment, a working solution, and an automated check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks that turn real, paid ML inference work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

â¢ Define the files, systems and environments each task runs on, such as model serving with streaming, so the challenge is realistic, reproducible and command-line solvable.

â¢ Write a working reference solution for every task and verify it runs end to end, sized for about 60 to 75 minutes of expert effort.

â¢ Build automated checks that objectively prove a result is correct, including cases where ML outputs go wrong silently, such as numerical drift or metric bugs.

â¢ Package tasks with Docker and Git so they are reproducible, and document the systems, tools, data and rules involved so reviewers can validate difficulty.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback and agent test runs, adjusting difficulty and fixing ambiguities so each task stays expert-level, fair and objectively gradable.

Skills/Experience

â¢ 3+ years doing ML inference or serving work hands-on (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD plus active research in the subfield

â¢ Did this work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

â¢ Trained, served or evaluated models at real scale (multi-GPU or production serving), not only notebooks or API calls

â¢ Hands-on with PyTorch or JAX internals and serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM

â¢ Can explain how ML results go wrong without errors (numerical drift, metric bugs) and how to catch them

â¢ Technical fluency in Python and the command line, and with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Availability to start by early November 2026 and complete tasks of about 60 to 75 minutes each

Nice-to-have

â¢ AI lab or LLM infrastructure experience

â¢ Contributions to PyTorch, vLLM or SGLang

â¢ GPU profiling experience

â¢ Docker and Git proficiency

â¢ Experience writing automated tests

Process

â¢ Task vetting instead of an interview: complete a vetting task so the client can assess your task design

â¢ Paid per task; each task takes about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Work is delivered task by task, with reviewer feedback on submissions

â¢ Expected start in early November 2026

ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

title: Client Accounting Division Manager
description: About Us Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B! At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees. We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us! Role Summary The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice. This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution. This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Division Performance and KPI Accountability Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets. Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard. Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level. Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions. Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients. Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability. Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams. People Leadership and Staffing Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns. Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles. Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations. Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout. Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution. Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount. Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines. Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly. Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry. Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model. Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope). Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations Client Relationships and Service Quality Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues. Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards. Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory. Growth and Operations Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows Group and Company Success A One Burkland mindset: Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland. Comfort with an increasing pace of change : Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done. Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency: Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it. A constructive attitude: Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance. Full adoption of firm tools and processes: Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well. Delivery and proactive advisory: Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers. Core Competencies & Skills Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness. Client Relationships â Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities. Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory. Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team. AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data. Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. raw.description:
About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrator, Customer Experience is critical to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Business Systems team and will lead generating, scoping, solutioning, and executing process and efficiency improvement efforts across customer-focused systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you. You will be responsible for the support, development, and maintenance of Salesforce and its related Customer Experience systems. You must own the pursuit of a world-class technology experience for our customers, while enabling scale and efficiency for internal customer experience teams - Support, Services, and Success. You need to have pride in the work you do and a passion for customer support and success. On a day to day basis, you will: Work with Services, Success, and Support teams to identify manual process that can be automated Scope, Plan, Recommend, and Deliver system solutions that help these teams meet their Objectives and Key Results Play a leading role in the exploration, design, build, delivery, and support of a redesigned and improved Customer Hub This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. You will have a knack for spotting opportunities to improve systems and process, and are excited to work cross-functionally to make it happen. You are passionate to build relationships to help others succeed. If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Business Systems Administrator is the career path for you! THE TEAM Our Salesloft’s Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming operational experts. Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired. The Revenue Operations team consists of team members that work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, Finance, and IT to create systems to more efficiently prospect, forecast, close, onboard, and support customers. Team members conceptualize the strategic priorities for the company, develop execution plans, execute plans cross-functionally, and operationalize executed strategies for continuous improvement. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!
